chapters.title: Chapter 5280: Dust I
paragraphs: Internally, everything about Noah had changed.

The nine Prime Causes burned through the Osmontian Infinite Bones. THE Osmontian Organ of Existence produced twin rivers of Observable and Unobservable Force simultaneously. Osmontian Absolute Infinity ran through foundations that had been rebuilt from the ground up by THE Infinite Cause’s emergence.
The being standing in the wreckage of the shattered Shelter of THE Loom was not the being who had arrived there.
None of it showed on the Primus Apeiron’s exterior. The multicolored Persevere flames rose and fell in their one-second rhythm. The scales caught the light the same way they had before.
The crystalline blue eyes held their cold calculation without broadcasting what the calculation was running on for his true form! His True Body!
Taylor looked at him anyway.

Her rapid eyes moved across his figure and then moved again and then stopped, holding on something her ability was receiving that her expression couldn’t fully organize around. She shook her head slowly.
"You fucking monster," she whispered. "Existence is over here buzzing with unreliable information about you that I can’t even focus on that other monster over there."
Noah shook his head.
"You’re going to want to focus on that monster over there."
Yes.
They were going to need to focus, because Sir William Arthur had turned fully toward the Gilded Legion, and Sir William Arthur demanded to be watched!

He stood Gigaparsecs from the Legion’s forward position and was nonetheless present , his existence pressing through the distance with the flat authority of something that didn’t require proximity to make its attention felt.

The obsidian stellar suit sat without adjustment on his frame. His dark hair remained precisely where it was. His hand rested against the sheath at his side with the casual readiness of someone who had done this many times.

His eyes moved across the Legion’s assembled formations with the unhurried assessment of a thorough man completing a thorough review, and when they found the cluster positioned behind the bodies of Taylor and Adrastia, the assessment paused.
He spoke.
"Existence is not a resource to be exploited simply because one possesses the capability to do so."
HUUM!
His voice carried across the locked Observable Existence.

"The capacity to act does not constitute a mandate to act. A being who can lift a mountain is not therefore obligated to drop it on ants, and a being who can traverse the architecture of time is not therefore justified in doing so to pursue outcomes that temporal mechanics have already rendered impossible."
He let that establish itself before continuing.

"The closed loop of temporal travel is not a theory. It is an observed and documented feature of how existence functions. The past cannot be changed. What occurred has occurred, and the record of its occurrence is woven into the fabric of existence at a depth that no force presently documented can revise. A being who travels backward into time and finds themselves present in a moment they previously were not present in has always been present in that moment.They are discovering their presence, not creating it."
His eyes remained on the cluster.

"However. A being who travels into the past with the specific intent to forcibly alter outcomes, who brings sufficient power to bear that they begin to pressure the set record rather than simply inhabit it, introduces instabilities into the fabric of existence that compound outward from the point of pressure. Existence does not accommodate revision. When revision is forced upon it, existence begins to unravel from the site of the forcing." He paused.

"The unraveling of existence is not something I regard with equanimity. The beings responsible for initiating it carry a verdict, and the verdict is death." He straightened slightly. "Are there any questions?"
BOOM!
The cluster behind Taylor and Adrastia went rigid.

The surrounding Gilded Ones turned toward the cluster with the collective attention of a formation discovering a problem in its own ranks, the astonishment moving through the assembled Ira and Superbius and the Silurian Ragnars in a visible wave that Mbaku tracked from his position with the expression of a commander absorbing unexpected information about his own forces.
Sororis Prima Elizabeth’s expression had gone heavy.
She was the leader. Leaders led.
"If any Gilded Ones within this formation have violated temporal protocols, they will be identified and remanded to our own disciplinary processes for—"

"My apologies if I was unclear." Sir William Arthur’s voice cut through hers without elevation or urgency. "My verdict applies specifically to the beings who violated time. As for those who choose to stand between me and the delivery of that verdict, the death of their Source is equally guaranteed. I should note that this is not a debate, nor a negotiation, nor a discussion of any kind."
He reached up with one hand and straightened his tie with two fingers."I shall get started."
HUUM!
Sororis Prima Elizabeth moved both hands outward and the power came at this time as she roared!
Billowing seas of Prime Cause authority and Existential Radiation surged around the full Legion formation, the compound expression of a Fourth Scale Gilded One erupting with glory!
The sea of power covered the assembled force in a visible golden pressure that pressed outward against the lockdown Sir William Arthur had established.
And at this time, a woman rose from in front of Adrastia and Taylor.

Her body went from contained to blazing in the span of a breath, Fourth Scale power erupting from her foundations with the intensity of something that had been held at suppressed levels during transit and had now stopped suppressing!
She rose above the formation’s front line, her existence burning at the tier that made the Silurian Ragnars beneath her look like a different category of being entirely.

"THE Osmontian needs to die regardless of cost! That violater needs to die regardless!" Her voice carried tremendous hatred of someone who had crossed time itself in service of a decision and was not revisiting it. "A Relictus appearing before us will not change that! IT! WILL! NOT! CHANGE!"
BOOM!
Behind her, three more.

Three other Fourth Scale entities rose from the formation’s body, the beings who had traversed through time alongside Vireth, each one burning at the tier that had made their presence the Legion’s actual offensive capability rather than decoration.

Observable Force fell under their collective influence across the lockdown zone, the ambient substance of the space responding to multiple simultaneous Fourth Scale expressions with the reluctant compliance of matter being commanded.
Then Vireth called out!
"Absolute Superbius Series: GILDED PEACOCK!"
HUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 5281: Dust II
paragraphs: The unique l Superbius capability unfurled from her foundations with the sustained backing of the Fourth Scale entities beside her and Sororis Prima Elizabeth and the ten Sororis Primas distributed through the formation!
The capability took form in the surrounding space rather than from any single point within it, the collective pride of a formation amd power at full expression finding a shape!
A Peacock!
Massive. Golden!

Its body composed not of physical material but of condensed Existential Radiation and Infinity and Observable Force and Superbius and Ira and Cause authority compounded across many Paleozoic Scale beings and multiple entities at the Fourth Scale, the form solid enough to press against the surrounding reality rather than simply occupying it!

Its tail spread across Gigaparsecs of observable space in a fan of golden feathers, each feather carrying concentrated pride that moved through the surrounding existence like a solvent, the emotion not expressing itself as a mood but as a physical condition, pride gushing from the form in waves that melted the structural coherence of the space it touched!
Its eyes burned crimson.

The eyes of Ira Gilded Ones who had fed their rage into the Superbius expression, the war-nature of the Bellum Cause running through the pride of the Cognitio Cause in a compound expression that made the peacock’s gaze not merely proud but hungry, its attention on Sir William Arthur bring imperious!
It was saying bow down!
How dare you stand before me!
The waves of pride reached Sir William!

They found him and ran across him and moved past him, and he remained exactly where he was, unblemished, his existence occupying the space the pride waves passed through with the flat indifference of something that had been introduced to pride and had found the introduction...unimpressive.
The golden solvent that had been melting the surrounding reality’s structural coherence found no purchase on his foundations.
He looked at the peacock.
He reached up with two fingers and straightened his tie.
His other hand closed around the hilt of the blade in the obsidian sheath.
He spoke as gloriously, it was a letter from THE Primordial Tongue!
"Destruere."
HUUM!
The draw was one motion.

From sheath to extension in a single arc, and from the blade’s edge as it completed the arc, a massive blow of obsidian liquid erupted, murky and dark and carrying the concentrated expression of THE Primordial Source in a physical form that existing classification frameworks had no adequate language for.

The liquid moved as a crescent, a curved obsidian flash that traveled at a speed the eye registered only as before and after rather than as motion, and it hit the peacock’s body and continued past it!
The crescent carved.

It carved through the pride waves and through the Existential Radiation that had been pressing against reality and through the collective Superbius authority of all Gilded and Fourth Scale expressions as though these were textures of the space rather than forces within it, and the carving did not stop at the peacock’s far side!

It continued outward through the Observable Existence itself, cutting through Gigaparsecs of space in the direction it had been sent, the obsidian liquid of THE Primordial Source expression splitting the entire region in half along the crescent’s path and sealing the cut in obsidian as it traveled!
OOOH!
The Observable Existence remained torn.
It would remain torn.
The peacock gushed.

The golden pride that composed its body erupted from the cut as blood erupted from a wound, the condensed Superbius authority pouring out of the severed form in golden cascades as the peacock’s structure lost coherence along the cut’s path and the loss of coherence spread outward from there, the entire form collapsing under the compound failure of the expressions that had been sustaining it.
Vireth dropped!

The three Fourth Scale entities who had traversed time dropped alongside her, and Sororis Prima Elizabeth dropped, and the ten Sororis Primas across the formation dropped, and the Devonian Ragnars dropped, and the Silurian formations staggered!
Every being in the assembled Legion who had fed their authority into the peacock expression receiving back through that feed the consequence of the expression’s total collapse!
Thousands of cuts appeared across their bodies simultaneously, the obsidian crescent’s passage through the collective expression leaving its record on every existence that had contributed to it.

Crimson-gold blood poured from the cuts in volumes that didn’t stop, the bodies of Devonian and Silurian Gilded Ones heaving as their existences rejected what had been done to the authorities they had invested, the rejection physically expressed.
They puked crimson-gold blood where they floated.
Their existences turned sickly.

Taylor grabbed her own arms with both hands and looked at herself and then looked around at the decimated Legion and then looked at Adrastia beside her and then let out a long exhale that ended in laughter.
"What the absolute fuck!" she said. "We’re fine! We’re completely fine! Holy shit!"
She laughed and cursed and laughed again, the release of someone who had spent an extended period convinced they were about to experience something terrible and had discovered they were not!
In the distance, Sir William Arthur began walking.

He walked toward Vireth unhurried, his blade back in its sheath, the obsidian liquid of THE Primordial Source no longer visible but its record written across the torn Observable Existence in every direction the crescent had traveled.

He looked at Vireth where she floated amid the cascade of crimson-gold blood and the sickly rejection her existence was producing, and at the three Fourth Scale entities beside her in equivalent states, and he spoke with the same measured precision he had applied to everything else.

"I find, in my experience, that most unfortunate situations trace directly back to a single original decision."He reached Vireth’s position and stopped. "Decisions compound. A single poor decision produces conditions that make the next poor decision feel necessary, and that decision produces conditions that make the one after it feel inevitable, and by the end of the chain, the beings involved have arrived at a destination they never consciously chose while having made every individual choice that led there."
He looked at Vireth with something that was not cruelty and was not compassion but was simply the attention of a being completing a task.
"You chose to travel. You chose to attempt revision. You chose to stand in the way of the verdict. Three decisions, each compounding on the last."
He tapped his hand outward once.
Vireth disappeared.
He tapped again.
The second Fourth Scale entity disappeared.
Again.
The third.
Again.
The fourth.
The space where they had been held the crimson-gold blood they had produced for a moment, floating in the torn Observable Existence, before the lockdown’s conditions dispersed it into the substrate.
Sir William Arthur straightened his jacket.
"Consequences," he said to no one in particular, "are simply decisions arriving at their natural destination."
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 5282: Dust III
paragraphs: Noah watched Sir William Arthur walk back from where Vireth and the other time-travelers had been.
One move. A single draw from an obsidian sheath, one letter of THE Primordial Tongue, and the crescent of liquid THE Primordial Source had done the rest!
Four Fourth Scale Gilded Ones, hundreds of Devonian Paleozoic Scale entities, the full pride expression of an assembled Legion’s collective Superbius authority, all of it had received one answer.
He let the full weight of what he’d witnessed settle into his assessment of what Sir William Arthur was!
He turned his eyes to what remained of the Legion.

They weren’t dead. He wasn’t sure whether that was mercy or something else entirely. The cuts covered every visible surface of every being who had contributed authority to the peacock expression, thousands of precise obsidian marks!
They were records. THE Primordial Source had passed through their existences and left its passage written on their foundations, and what the passage had written wasdegradation.
The prompts bloomed as he sought information.
|Legion status: critical existential degradation active across all entities who contributed authority to the collapsed Superbius formation.|

|The crescent expression of THE Primordial Source has introducedTHE Source Rejection Conditioninto the foundations of affected entities. THE Source Rejection Condition functions as follows:the foundational substrate of existence recognizes these beings as having participated in a collective action that drew THE Primordial Source’s direct correction.The substrate is now actively withdrawing its support for their continued coherence.|

|Symptoms: cuts across all surfaces of existence that do not seal, progressive loss of Cause connection as THE First Cause withdraws recognition from affected foundations, continuous involuntary expulsion of cultivated force through open wounds, destabilization of Scale standing, degradation of Ego architecture.The condition worsens with time and accelerates with any attempt to use cultivated capabilities.|

|Prognosis: without direct intervention from a being with THE Primordial Source access, affected entities will continue degrading until their foundational coherence collapses entirely. Current trajectory places full collapse between several hours and several days depending on individual foundational strength.|

|Note: The time-traversing entities have been removed from existence entirely. The Rejection Condition applies only to those who participated in the formation while remaining within their original temporal context.|
|Observable Existence lockdown: lifted. Sir William Arthur has rescinded the entry and exit restriction. Transit through Observable Existence is now unrestricted.|
Taylor was already moving.
She had Adrastia by the arm and was pulling him away from the nearest cluster of degrading Gilded Ones!
As she pulled, she looked sideways toward the distant figure of Sir William Arthur and raised her voice.
"Thank you for not killing those of us who weren’t involved, big guy!"She kept moving while she said it, not breaking her stride. "We will absolutely get out of your way!"
She disappeared into the space between the Legion’s scattered formations with Adrastia in tow.

Noah watched them go and returned his attention to the broader scene, cataloguing the Legion’s current state, the degrading Sororis Prima and Devonian and Silurian entities dispersed across Observable Existence in various stages of the Rejection Condition, Sororis Prima Elizabeth cutting and bleeding and still upright with pride!
As he looked at all of this...
WUU!
He frowned.
He looked up.

Space shattered above the Observable Existence, the dimensional fabric splitting along lines that hadn’t been stressed before, and through the splits came an entity that Noah’s perception registered before his eyes resolved the details.
Superbius.

Liquid swirling rivers of it, the Ego not merely expressed but composed into the entity’s physical substance, the pride of the Superbius designation compressed into a body that was ten times the mass of even a Devonian Ragnar, the titanic frame descending through the shattered space with the cold unhurried attention of something that had arrived to assess.
To assess!
The entity’s expression held no rage, no urgency. Just the cold evaluative attention of something that had sent a Legion ahead of itself and had come personally to review the results.
Noah focused everything available on the entity.
Not a partial reading. Just nothing. Pure question marks where information should exist, the substrate around this entity refusing to yield even a name!
Terrifyingly powerful!

The entity’s gaze moved across the degraded Legion, across the torn Observable Existence where Sir William Arthur’s crescent had carved its permanent record, across the crimson-gold staining the space around the fallen, and then the gaze found Sir William Arthur.
"We never would have expected to see a genuine Source Lifeform here." The entity’s voice was massive and flat.
"We began paying attention after our people started dying here, and now for a Gilded Legion to be struck down with your appearance in this region."It looked at the degraded formations.
"We have taken too many losses, haven’t we? It seems there is an infestation occurring, and we now have to clear it out."
BOOM!
Sir William Arthur looked up at the entity.
His expression, which had carried the precise neutrality of professional focus through the entire engagement, shifted by a fraction as it became cold.
"You wouldn’t,"he said.
The entity smiled.
It was a brutal smile that had nothing warm in it.

"Oh, but it is already done. The order has been given. I was sent to confirm, and I have confirmed."It looked down at Sir William Arthur with the patient attention of something that had all the time available to it that it needed.
"We shall meet again soon. After the dust has settled."
After the dust has settled.
After the dust has settled!
Noah’s expression went heavy the moment the words finished!
He gave his order to THE Infiniverse immediately, the command moving through their connection before his conscious processing had fully completed its assessment of what the words implied!
Because his instincts had already completed the assessment and his instincts had been right for long enough that he’d learned to move on them without waiting for confirmation!

Across the space, Sir William Arthur’s frown deepened. He turned from the entity and tapped his hand outward toward the positions Taylor and Adrastia and the other anomalies occupied, and the anomalies went still as the tap reached them!
Then... the space above cracked.
HOONG!

Massive silver-gold pillars of metallic light descended through the cracks in the Observable Existence’s upper dimensional fabric, each one the size of a Primordial Realm, the space shattering along their entry paths in ways that wouldn’t reseal because the pillars weren’t moving through the space but replacing it, the silver-gold light occupying the coordinates of the dimensional fabric rather than traveling through them!
They were menacing in the way that things designed to be final were menacing!
Noah’s senses screamed as he gazed at this!
The prompts arrived with the flat urgency of information that needed to be processed immediately.
|Incoming deployment: Ealdor-class Existential Acedia Ordnance. Multiple warheads confirmed.|

|Classification: Taboo capability reverse-engineered from THE First Cause, combined with the Ego of Acedia. Classified by Gilded engineering councils as a weapon of last resort. Deployment against Observable Existences or large-scale regions is sanctioned only at the highest levels of THE Magna Sorora authority.|

|Effect upon detonation:The targeted region undergoes Causal Stilling. THE First Cause’s expression is inverted and weaponized as it removes all progression from the affected space. Every form of advancement, cultivation, growth, healing, and development ceases within the Stilled region permanently.The Causal Stilling does not disperse. It persists until actively reversed by a being with direct access to THE First Cause’s authority.|

|Secondary effect:Existential Acedia Dredge conversion.All lifeforms within the detonation radius are transformed by the Causal Stilling into Existential Acedia Dredges. Dredge state characteristics: complete loss of independent cognizance, existence locked into a single imperative of seeking and infecting other lifeforms, bodies continuing to operate without cultivation or growth or healing, wounds present but non-fatal, movements driven by the Acedia Ego’s imperative rather than any surviving will. Dredges respond exclusively to the signature of Gilded Ones bearing Acedia Ego.|

|Tertiary effect:Existential Acedia Infection.Dredges carry the Causal Stilling in their physical substance. Any lifeform that comes into contact with a Dredge’s bodily output, or sustains injury from a Dredge, receives the Infection directly into their foundational substrate. The Infection binds irreversibly into the recipient’s existence within moments of contact. Once bound, the Infection progresses toward full Dredge conversion regardless of the recipient’s foundational strength.Fourth Scale entities exposed to the Infection without immediate Source-level intervention will convert. Third Scale entities convert within seconds of binding.|
|Current trajectory: Multiple warheads are approaching detonation range for this Observable Existence. Estimated time to detonation:Instantaneous.|
He had to move!
He had to move right now, and he was already moving, the order to THE Infiniverse already sent!

sentences.text: Noah watched Sir William Arthur walk back from where Vireth and the other time-travelers had been.
One move.
A single draw from an obsidian sheath, one letter of THE Primordial Tongue, and the crescent of liquid THE Primordial Source had done the rest!
Four Fourth Scale Gilded Ones, hundreds of Devonian Paleozoic Scale entities, the full pride expression of an assembled Legion’s collective Superbius authority, all of it had received one answer.
He let the full weight of what he’d witnessed settle into his assessment of what Sir William Arthur was!
He turned his eyes to what remained of the Legion.
They weren’t dead.
He wasn’t sure whether that was mercy or something else entirely.
The cuts covered every visible surface of every being who had contributed authority to the peacock expression, thousands of precise obsidian marks!
They were records.
THE Primordial Source had passed through their existences and left its passage written on their foundations, and what the passage had written wasdegradation.
The prompts bloomed as he sought information.
|Legion status: critical existential degradation active across all entities who contributed authority to the collapsed Superbius formation.|
|The crescent expression of THE Primordial Source has introducedTHE Source Rejection Conditioninto the foundations of affected entities.

THE Source Rejection Condition functions as follows:the foundational substrate of existence recognizes these beings as having participated in a collective action that drew THE Primordial Source’s direct correction.The substrate is now actively withdrawing its support for their continued coherence.|

|Symptoms: cuts across all surfaces of existence that do not seal, progressive loss of Cause connection as THE First Cause withdraws recognition from affected foundations, continuous involuntary expulsion of cultivated force through open wounds, destabilization of Scale standing, degradation of Ego architecture.The condition worsens with time and accelerates with any attempt to use cultivated capabilities.|
|Prognosis: without direct intervention from a being with THE Primordial Source access, affected entities will continue degrading until their foundational coherence collapses entirely.
Current trajectory places full collapse between several hours and several days depending on individual foundational strength.|
|Note: The time-traversing entities have been removed from existence entirely.
The Rejection Condition applies only to those who participated in the formation while remaining within their original temporal context.|
|Observable Existence lockdown: lifted.
Sir William Arthur has rescinded the entry and exit restriction.
Transit through Observable Existence is now unrestricted.|
Taylor was already moving.
She had Adrastia by the arm and was pulling him away from the nearest cluster of degrading Gilded Ones!
As she pulled, she looked sideways toward the distant figure of Sir William Arthur and raised her voice.
"Thank you for not killing those of us who weren’t involved, big guy!"She kept moving while she said it, not breaking her stride.
"We will absolutely get out of your way!"
She disappeared into the space between the Legion’s scattered formations with Adrastia in tow.

Noah watched them go and returned his attention to the broader scene, cataloguing the Legion’s current state, the degrading Sororis Prima and Devonian and Silurian entities dispersed across Observable Existence in various stages of the Rejection Condition, Sororis Prima Elizabeth cutting and bleeding and still upright with pride!
As he looked at all of this...
WUU!
He frowned.
He looked up.

Space shattered above the Observable Existence, the dimensional fabric splitting along lines that hadn’t been stressed before, and through the splits came an entity that Noah’s perception registered before his eyes resolved the details.
Superbius.

Liquid swirling rivers of it, the Ego not merely expressed but composed into the entity’s physical substance, the pride of the Superbius designation compressed into a body that was ten times the mass of even a Devonian Ragnar, the titanic frame descending through the shattered space with the cold unhurried attention of something that had arrived to assess.
To assess!
The entity’s expression held no rage, no urgency.
Just the cold evaluative attention of something that had sent a Legion ahead of itself and had come personally to review the results.
Noah focused everything available on the entity.
Not a partial reading.
Just nothing.
Pure question marks where information should exist, the substrate around this entity refusing to yield even a name!
Terrifyingly powerful!

The entity’s gaze moved across the degraded Legion, across the torn Observable Existence where Sir William Arthur’s crescent had carved its permanent record, across the crimson-gold staining the space around the fallen, and then the gaze found Sir William Arthur.
"We never would have expected to see a genuine Source Lifeform here." The entity’s voice was massive and flat.
"We began paying attention after our people started dying here, and now for a Gilded Legion to be struck down with your appearance in this region."It looked at the degraded formations.
"We have taken too many losses, haven’t we?
It seems there is an infestation occurring, and we now have to clear it out."
BOOM!
Sir William Arthur looked up at the entity.
His expression, which had carried the precise neutrality of professional focus through the entire engagement, shifted by a fraction as it became cold.
"You wouldn’t,"he said.
The entity smiled.
It was a brutal smile that had nothing warm in it.
"Oh, but it is already done.
The order has been given.
I was sent to confirm, and I have confirmed."It looked down at Sir William Arthur with the patient attention of something that had all the time available to it that it needed.
"We shall meet again soon.
After the dust has settled."
After the dust has settled.
After the dust has settled!
Noah’s expression went heavy the moment the words finished!
He gave his order to THE Infiniverse immediately, the command moving through their connection before his conscious processing had fully completed its assessment of what the words implied!
Because his instincts had already completed the assessment and his instincts had been right for long enough that he’d learned to move on them without waiting for confirmation!
Across the space, Sir William Arthur’s frown deepened.
He turned from the entity and tapped his hand outward toward the positions Taylor and Adrastia and the other anomalies occupied, and the anomalies went still as the tap reached them!
Then... the space above cracked.
HOONG!

Massive silver-gold pillars of metallic light descended through the cracks in the Observable Existence’s upper dimensional fabric, each one the size of a Primordial Realm, the space shattering along their entry paths in ways that wouldn’t reseal because the pillars weren’t moving through the space but replacing it, the silver-gold light occupying the coordinates of the dimensional fabric rather than traveling through them!
They were menacing in the way that things designed to be final were menacing!
Noah’s senses screamed as he gazed at this!
The prompts arrived with the flat urgency of information that needed to be processed immediately.
|Incoming deployment: Ealdor-class Existential Acedia Ordnance.
Multiple warheads confirmed.|
|Classification: Taboo capability reverse-engineered from THE First Cause, combined with the Ego of Acedia.
Classified by Gilded engineering councils as a weapon of last resort.
Deployment against Observable Existences or large-scale regions is sanctioned only at the highest levels of THE Magna Sorora authority.|
|Effect upon detonation:The targeted region undergoes Causal Stilling.
THE First Cause’s expression is inverted and weaponized as it removes all progression from the affected space.
Every form of advancement, cultivation, growth, healing, and development ceases within the Stilled region permanently.The Causal Stilling does not disperse.
It persists until actively reversed by a being with direct access to THE First Cause’s authority.|
|Secondary effect:Existential Acedia Dredge conversion.All lifeforms within the detonation radius are transformed by the Causal Stilling into Existential Acedia Dredges.

Dredge state characteristics: complete loss of independent cognizance, existence locked into a single imperative of seeking and infecting other lifeforms, bodies continuing to operate without cultivation or growth or healing, wounds present but non-fatal, movements driven by the Acedia Ego’s imperative rather than any surviving will.
Dredges respond exclusively to the signature of Gilded Ones bearing Acedia Ego.|

The Infection binds irreversibly into the recipient’s existence within moments of contact.

Once bound, the Infection progresses toward full Dredge conversion regardless of the recipient’s foundational strength.Fourth Scale entities exposed to the Infection without immediate Source-level intervention will convert.
Third Scale entities convert within seconds of binding.|

Estimated time to detonation:Instantaneous.|

He had to move right now, and he was already moving, the order to THE Infiniverse already sent!

chapters.title: Chapter 5283: Causal Stilling! I
paragraphs: There are beings in existence who have moved past the point where process matters to them.
It was not because they began without conscience or without the capacity to weigh the cost of their actions against the outcomes they sought.

Some of them began with both. But somewhere across the span of their existence, across the accumulated weight of setbacks and humiliations and the bitterness of power that arrived too late to save the things it should have saved, the calculation changed.
What they wanted became the only variable. The cost of getting it became a number they stopped looking at.

When beings like this are given weapons, they use them the way anyone uses a tool they’ve decided they don’t have to be careful with. Completely. Without exception.Without regard for what else is in the room.
This is what absolute desperation looks like when it has been given enough power to act.
They appeared over everything simultaneously, not moving from one region to the next in a progression that would have given anything below time to respond.

The Ealdor-class Existential Acedia Ordnancesarrived across the full expanse of the lower Observable Existence in a single coordinated moment, the silver-gold pillars of metallic light cracking the dimensional fabric above every region at once.
Above Jotunheim, three pillars cracked the frozen sky.

THE Great Usurper had been moving through the frost with his chaos giants and usurped Gilded Ones. He looked up with the cold devilish expression he brought to most things, and then the expression changed, and it changed fast.
He had just enough time to speak.

"Together!" he said to the chaos giants around him, and they came together, the massive irregular forms pressing into each other in the instinctive clustering of beings who understood that what was above them required everything they had.
That the Unity running through them all blazed with the desperate brightness of something trying to become more than the sum of its parts in the seconds remaining.
The pillars detonated!
BOOOOM!

The silver-gold light erupted outward from every point simultaneously, the Causal Stilling spreading across Jotunheim’s frost-covered geography in a wave that moved through the substrate of the realm rather than across its surface, touching every coordinate at once rather than spreading from a central point!
The frost didn’t melt. It went still, and still here meant something different from the ordinary stillness of a cold thing in a cold place.
Still meant that the frost would never change again, would never shift or melt or refreeze or do any of the things that frost did as a condition of being frost that existed in time.
The chaos giants felt it hit them.

The silver-gold light moved through their massive irregular bodies and the Unity that THE Great Usurper had built between them began coming apart systematically, the connection dissolving at the precise points where the Causal Stilling found the progression embedded in the Unity’s architecture and removed it.
Their expressions changed in the moments before the full conversion.
What remained was not them.

What remained stood in the frost of Jotunheim and looked at nothing, and looked at everything with the same flat attention, and began to move with the purposeless purpose of the converted, the silver-gold luminescence of the Acedia Stilling running through the massive frames that had held chaos giants!
The body of Abaddon, occupied by THE Great Usurper, had taken the full force of the detonation.
Whether anything of the Usurper remained within it was a question the frost of Jotunheim did not answer.
In the vast Early Veiled Shore that THE Creature had maintained as a refuge, the scale of what was kept there was not visible from any single vantage point.

Early Creatures and Living Existences and Fold Dwellers from the furthest and strangest corners of the lower Observable Existence were here, beings who existed at the very foundation of what life in this domain looked like before.
They all looked up at the same moment.

The silver-gold light appeared across the entire sky of the Shore simultaneously, the pillars cracking the upper space above the golden sands and the vast dark waters and the ancient vegetation that had grown in the warmth of whatever THE Creature’s protection had provided.
BOOM!
The light came down and went through everything.

The Early Creatures that had no defense mechanisms for this event, and what replaced their movement was the flat purposeless shuffle of the converted, their ancient forms still intact but no longer doing anything that the forms had been designed to do.

The Living Existences pressed against the Stilling with everything they had and were insufficient, the Stilling not caring about the distinction. It was targeting change. And everything changed.And so everything was stopped.
The silver-gold luminescence spread across the Shore in waves, and then it settled, and then the Shore was full of things that moved with wrong purpose toward anything that hadn’t yet been touched.
Existential Acedia Dredges, with skin carrying a deathly silver light and eyes with no cognizance bloomed.
In Helheim, THE Primordial Paradox had been watching his student.

Erwin had grown into something extraordinary, the massive circular form of him pulsing with information and paradox in the slow rhythms of a being whose consciousness had expanded past the point where his prior physical form could have expressed it.

He had been feeding on information, on the very Scales of existence, growing denser and stranger with each consumption, the obsidian mass of him carrying the wrongness of something that had passed through existential unraveling.
THE Primordial Paradox saw the light appear above Helheim and felt something he hadn’t felt in a very long time.
He roared.

The sound moved through Helheim’s space, and from within him, an Infinity that wasn’t his own surged outward in response, the specific multicolored warmth of something that had been left there by someone else, pressing against the silver-gold light as it descended through Helheim’s obsidian sky.
It was not enough.

The Causal Stilling moved through the resistance the way water moved through a grate, occupying every gap the resistance created, finding every coordinate the outward Infinity surge didn’t cover and Stilling it before the surge could expand to address it.

THE Primordial Paradox’s ancient foundations backed by a certain multicolored infinity barely held, the depth of what he was providing enough structural coherence that the Stilling couldn’t find immediate purchase in his core.
But the Stilling was patient, and it seemed only a matter of time.
He turned to look at Erwin.
The massive circular obsidian mass of his student was already changing.

The silver-gold light of the Existential Acedia had found the information that composed Erwin’s expanded form and had begun moving through it the way a toxin moved through a bloodstream, not destroying what it found but altering it.
The wrongness of the Acedia Stilling rewrote the purpose of the information even as the information itself remained present.

The obsidian surface of the circular mass was developing a silver glow that moved in pulses from the exterior inward, each pulse pushing deeper into the mass’s core, each pulse making the mass less the thing it had been.
The massive form twitched.
Then it turned.
It didn’t look at anything with recognition!

chapters.title: Chapter 5284: Causal Stilling! II
paragraphs: The many-faced locus that had carried Erwin’s evolving consciousness had gone flat behind the silver glow, the expressions no longer cycling through their configurations but fixed in the flatness of something whose internal process had been removed and replaced with a single imperative.
An Existential Acedia Dredge.
The glorious Living Paradox. THE Information Paradox!
Turned and altered by something that even a Fourth Scale Existence could not stand against!
The obsidian tentacles that had moved with the complex purpose of a being engaged with existence moved now with the simple purpose of something seeking contact and infection.
THE Primordial Paradox looked at what his student had become as even he...was barely keeping his cognizance.
He said nothing, but his eyes showed a sense of sadness...and pity!
In THE Wastes, Alexander felt it coming before it arrived.
The Enneagram on his chest blazed with multicolored Infinity, and from that connection something moved outward through Alexander’s foundations with the urgency of a warning.
He looked up at the silver-gold pillars cracking the sky above THE Wastes.
He drew his bow as he roared!
OOOH!
The Infinity from THE Genesis Monarch’s mark poured through the bow and into the arrow he pulled from nothing, the multicolored light of it blazing against the silver-gold of the descending Stilling!
He released with everything he had toward the nearest pillar in a gesture that was... simply the refusal of a being who could not accept without resisting.
The arrow hit.
The pillar’s light swallowed it.
The Causal Stilling reached Alexander and moved through the outer layers of his foundations, and he felt the progressive absence of the thing being taken more disturbing than the taking itself!
He fought it with every technique available to him and with the Infinity still pouring through the Enneagram and he held, barely.
He was crying.
He was crying and fighting and neither the crying nor the fighting had any dignity in them!
Because this was not a dignified moment!
This was the lower Observable Existence in the process of being ended by beings who had made a calculation!
At this time...
The Existential Acedia Dredges were already moving through the Observable Existence.
Whether they were Fold Dwellers to Formless Terrors to Primordial Architect within THE Wyld, they all became Existential Acedia Dredges!

They had been beings of every kind and classification before the Stilling, and now they were uniform in their wrongness, silver-gold light running through bodies that still functioned as bodies, but pursued a single purpose that the silver-gold imperative had replaced every other purpose with.
The lower Observable Existence had been a place where extraordinary beings had done extraordinary things across eons of extraordinary conflict.
In the silence following the Ordnances, it was something else.
THE Infiniverse was gone from the lower Observable Existence before the Ordnances finished their detonation.

She had moved the moment Noah’s order reached her through their connection, the Vessel Severance capability carrying her into THE Undefined Gaps with the completeness of a domain that had been built with exactly this kind of departure in mind. The Calabi-Yau folding had been her concealment. THE Undefined Gaps were her escape, the unclassified regions between defined existence providing cover that no Ealdor-class deployment could reach because those deployments had been designed for Observable Existence, and she was no longer there.

She carried everyone inside her. Every being Noah’s people had brought into her domain across the full span of her development, every Early Creature and Living Existence and Fold Dweller and cultivator who had made her their home, all of them present within her substrate as she moved through THE Undefined Gaps. The emergence event had drawn his people back inside for its completion, a timing that had felt like administrative necessity at the time and had become the specific grace of a thing that saved everything it touched without knowing it was doing so.
If they had been outside, they would not have been saved.
Noah stood in THE Early Veiled Shore with the nine Prime Cause lights burning through his Osmontian Infinite Physique and said nothing.
Because there was nothing to say that the situation hadn’t already said more completely and with considerably more authority.
Beside his Primus Apeiron body, Taylor stood.

She had been communicating with existence from the moment the Ordnances detonated, the ability that had made her valuable enough to kidnap working now in the direction it had always been designed to work.
Existence was feeding her information about everything it was experiencing simultaneously across the lower Observable Existence.
Her face moved through expressions in rapid succession and settled on fury, the fury of a being receiving detailed information about something catastrophic.
"How could they do this?" The words came out compressed under their own weight."I know there is no such thing as good or evil but, really? REALLY?!"

She looked at the space around her, at the Early Veiled Shore that no longer touched the lower Observable Existence it had occupied an hour ago."I lived with Gilded Ones peacefully in my Observable Existence. I didn’t...they shouldn’t...really?!"
Her eyes blazed with the fury of a ruler! Even though she did not belong here, she still felt!
Noah was not expressive.
His rage burned so far inward that nothing of it reached his exterior.
The crystalline blue of his eyes carrief the specific chill of Osmontian Absolute Infinity burning through the Ira Ego hidden inside at full expression.
Nine lights. Nine Prime Causes. The complete fury of a being who had built something grand!
He breathed out.
He shifted into his Humilitas Ego of Infinity.
A void of humility and surrender wrapped around him with the cold completeness of nothingness made substantial, and he took a step and disappeared from THE Early Veiled Shore.
The lower Observable Existence received him.

He arrived where the Primus Apeiron body had stood befofr and felt the effects of the exploded Ealdor-class Existential Acedia Ordnances moving through the surrounding space as a pervasive condition rather than an active attack, the Causal Stilling having already settled into the fabric of the space and become indistinguishable from the space itself.

The silver-gold luminescence of the Acedia sat in the substrate of everything he could perceive, coating the geometry of the region the way frost coated terrain, and it pressed against him from every direction simultaneously.
It found nothing.
|Osmontian Absolute Infinity- active engagement with Ealdor-class Existential Acedia Ordnance effects.|

If they had been outside, they would not have been saved.
Noah stood in THE Early Veiled Shore with the nine Prime Cause lights burning through his Osmontian Infinite Physique and said nothing.
Because there was nothing to say that the situation hadn’t already said more completely and with considerably more authority.
Beside his Primus Apeiron body, Taylor stood.

She had been communicating with existence from the moment the Ordnances detonated, the ability that had made her valuable enough to kidnap working now in the direction it had always been designed to work.
Existence was feeding her information about everything it was experiencing simultaneously across the lower Observable Existence.
Her face moved through expressions in rapid succession and settled on fury, the fury of a being receiving detailed information about something catastrophic.
"How could they do this?" The words came out compressed under their own weight."I know there is no such thing as good or evil but, really?
REALLY?!"

She looked at the space around her, at the Early Veiled Shore that no longer touched the lower Observable Existence it had occupied an hour ago."I lived with Gilded Ones peacefully in my Observable Existence.
I didn’t...they shouldn’t...really?!"
Her eyes blazed with the fury of a ruler!
Even though she did not belong here, she still felt!
Noah was not expressive.
His rage burned so far inward that nothing of it reached his exterior.
The crystalline blue of his eyes carrief the specific chill of Osmontian Absolute Infinity burning through the Ira Ego hidden inside at full expression.
Nine lights.
Nine Prime Causes.
The complete fury of a being who had built something grand!
He breathed out.
He shifted into his Humilitas Ego of Infinity.
A void of humility and surrender wrapped around him with the cold completeness of nothingness made substantial, and he took a step and disappeared from THE Early Veiled Shore.
The lower Observable Existence received him.

He arrived where the Primus Apeiron body had stood befofr and felt the effects of the exploded Ealdor-class Existential Acedia Ordnances moving through the surrounding space as a pervasive condition rather than an active attack, the Causal Stilling having already settled into the fabric of the space and become indistinguishable from the space itself.

The silver-gold luminescence of the Acedia sat in the substrate of everything he could perceive, coating the geometry of the region the way frost coated terrain, and it pressed against him from every direction simultaneously.
It found nothing.
|Osmontian Absolute Infinity- active engagement with Ealdor-class Existential Acedia Ordnance effects.|

chapters.title: Chapter 5285: Causal Stilling! III
paragraphs: |Standard Absolute Infinity is the total and unrestricted expression of Infinity in its most complete form, acknowledging no ceiling and no boundary.|

|In its standard definition, Absolute Infinity achieves totality by removing all limitations including the identity of the being expressing it. This is not a flaw in the definition. It is a necessary condition of absoluteness, since any identity imposes a perspective, andperspective is a limitation.|

|Osmontian Absolute Infinity operates on a different definitional foundation.The identity of Noah Osmont is not a limitation imposed on the Absolute expression. It is a specification of which Absolute expression this is. Osmontian Absolute Infinity is the complete and unrestricted expression of Infinity as it exists through the specific nature of Noah Osmont’s existence, with his tyranny, his harvest, his paradoxical cheating, his nine Prime Cause integrations, and his foundational Civilizations all present as components of the Infinity rather than as constraints on it.|

|The practical consequence: where standard Absolute Infinity would express itself as an undifferentiated total, Osmontian Absolute Infinity expresses itself as a total that carries Noah Osmont’s identity through every coordinate it occupies. Force directed against him encounters not merely Infinity but Infinity organized around and through his specific identity.|
|Momentum directed against him is redirected not by a barrier but by an Infinity that understands what it is protecting and has built that understanding into its expression.|
|Power that attempts to infiltrate his foundations finds an Infinity that is his identity, and his identity is not something the infiltrating power can occupy because his identity is already there.|

|The Ealdor-class Existential Acedia Ordnance effects function by finding the capacity for change in a target’s foundations and removing it. Osmontian Absolute Infinity presents no capacity for change that the Stilling can locate, because the Infinity is not a static architecture with changeable components.|

|It is a dynamic expression of a living identity that changes as the identity changes, meaning the Stilling cannot find a stable target within it. The infection mechanism of the Existential Acedia Dredges functions by binding into foundational substrate. Osmontian Absolute Infinity is not substrate. It is expressed identity, and identity cannot be bound by a condition that requires something static to bind to.|
|The Ordnance effects have been denied entirely. Your foundations are unaffected.|

|Observable Existence analysis:comprehensive degradation confirmed across all regions. The Causal Stilling is active in every surveyed coordinate. Lifeform conversion to Existential Acedia Dredge state is estimated above ninety nine percent of the total prior population.|

|Remaining unconverted existences are either fighting active infection or operating with protection that the Ordnances were not calibrated to overcome. Observable Existence is functionally non-operational as a domain supporting standard cultivation or living activity. The Stilling is permanent without Source-level intervention.|
The prompts were heavy!
He walked, and he did so with purpose towards...a friend.
He crossed distances the way he crossed distances now, with the understanding that distance was a suggestion his Infinity could decline.
The space between his arrival point and Alexander’s position compressed into the number of steps he chose to take rather than the number the geography required.
Alexander was seated on what had been a Shelter of THE Loom.
There was no shelter left. There were the remnants of one, the architectural bones of something that had been built to endure and had encountered an ordnance that had not cared about durability.
Alexander sat on its largest surviving fragment with the posture of someone who had stopped trying to hold themselves upright.
The silver-gold of the Acedia Infection ran through him visibly.

It moved in pulses from his extremities toward his core, each pulse pushing deeper than the last, his body fighting the progression with the Infinity from the Enneagram on his chest blazing against it in multicolored bursts that arrived and faded and arrived again.

His eyes held recognition when they found Noah, which meant there was still something operating behind them that the infection hadn’t reached yet, but the recognition shared space with the flat purposeless expression of the conversion, the two states alternating through his face in the horror of a being who could feel themselves becoming something else and couldn’t stop it.
He looked at Noah.
He opened his mouth.
"I...always believed I was the center of my own story."

"That I could do great things. That my future held unbound glory for me to discover. It felt true. It felt like something that couldn’t be argued with because when you look at your own existence from the inside, it always looks like the center."
He paused as a pulse of silver-gold moved through his arm and he pushed back against it with the Infinity blazing from the Enneagram, the effort visible in the tension across his face.

"I sought peace above everything else. For the sake of peace, I wanted to grasp as much power as I could so that my peace would hold regardless of what existence decided to do around me. So even after setbacks, even after Beowulf put me through things I don’t speak about, I didn’t give up. I received Infinity as a gift and I was grateful for it."
His eyes held Noah’s as they shook. "But I didn’t want to stay inside THE Infiniverse. I wanted to seek my own fortune. My own power. All because of my pride."
He touched his chest.
The Enneagram blazed under his hand.
"I have my family inside here. Every person I made a promise to, every being who trusted that being near me meant they were safer than they would have been alone. I... put them all in grave danger."

The words came out with the self-devastation of someone stating a fact they can’t argue themselves out of."I used every ounce of the gifted Infinity in my existence to protect this, to make sure the infection didn’t spread into them. To make sure what happened to me didn’t happen to the ones inside."
He looked at the Enneagram for a moment.
"I...am done. I am...done. I didn’t want to put my safety in the hands of another, and because of that, I endangered the ones closest to me. Please."
He looked at Noah.
"Can you ensure their safety? I am already infected. I don’t..."
He shook his head.
The motion was half voluntary and half the specific tremor of a body that had been fighting an infection for too long and was fighting harder in some moments than others.

He pressed his hand into his chest and the Enneagram resisted being removed for a moment, the connection between it and his foundations running deep enough that separating them hurt in ways he didn’t express, and then he pressed harder and it came free and he held it out!
Noah took it!

chapters.title: Chapter 5286: Through Adversity I
paragraphs: His gaze was hardened in the way of a being who was feeling more than he was showing.
Noah was not...overly expressive even at a time like this.
Alexander looked at the Enneagram in Noah’s hand and then back at Noah.
"Existence is not a story," he said. "We are not destined beings promised greatness. Existence is brutal. Existence is unfair. Existence does not care."
He steadied himself against a pulse of silver-gold that moved through his torso and pushed back with what Infinity remained accessible to him.
"One has to know when to take a step back. I am taking one now."
He met Noah’s eyes.

"Take care of my people, please. I don’t know if the chance still exists for me. This infection feels far too grand. But I am still fighting it. If you have the capability, I will even rely on you for this. I still have my last shred of stubbornness. I still...want to try."
Something moved through his expression that was not hope and was not despair.
It was his own brilliance that refused to fade even now!
"After all, existence is also filled with adversity."
He looked at Noah.
"And one has to persevere."
BOOM!
Noah looked at him and felt the full weight of what Alexander didn’t know, which was that he had already done the thing he was asking for permission to try.

He had survived an Ealdor-class Existential Acedia Ordnance. He had held the infection back long enough to protect the Enneagram. He had maintained enough cognizance to make the decision he had just made while actively converting.
Fourth Scale existences would have gone down to this same infection without the combination of gifted Infinity and foundational stubbornness Alexander had brought to fighting it!
He had already persevered!
He had already done more than enough!
Noah held the Enneagram and looked at Alexander and said nothing for a moment.
Then he moved.
He sat beside Alexander.

He lowered himself onto the fragment of shattered Shelter, and the silver-gold luminescence of the Acedia Infection pressing outward from Alexander’s body found the Osmontian Absolute Infinity around him and...could do nothing.
He looked at the man beside him.
"You are feeling the way you are because you have decided that needing help is the same as failing,"he said. "It isn’t."

He held Alexander’s gaze with flat certainty. "You went outside. You sought your own fortune. You used what you were given and pushed past everything Beowulf put you through and every setback existence put in your path, and you kept moving. That is not the profile of a being who failed. That is the profile of a being who tried."
A silver-gold pulse moved through Alexander’s shoulder and he pushed against it automatically, the Infinity blazing in response.

"Pride has one genuine failure," Noah continued, "and it isn’t needing help. The failure is looking at where you are right now, beaten down and infected and sitting in the ruins of a Shelter, and deciding that because you couldn’t make it on your own outside, the whole attempt was a failure. That is the pride that destroys things. Not the act of extending your hand."He let that land. "You... have not failed."
Alexander’s expression moved.

"Failure is part of the process. I have failed more times than I can count. Every existence that has ever become something worth becoming has a catalog of failures behind it, and the ones who kept going are not the ones who never needed to be picked up. They are the ones who, when they were beaten down, had something... to reach for."
Noah looked at the devastated landscape of the lower Observable Existence around them, the silver-gold Stilling coating everything the eye could find.

"The connections you have are part of your power. Not a replacement for your power. Part of it. Having someone to help you up when you are down can sometimes be everything. Sometimes all one needs is a helping hand."
He stood.
He turned to Alexander and held out his hand.
Alexander looked at it for a moment with heavy crimson eyes as his existence seemed to be crying out! Then he reached up and took it.
HUUM!

Osmontian Absolute Infinity erupted from Noah’s hand and wrapped around Alexander in a bubble of surging multicolored light, the nine Prime Cause expressions running through the bubble’s surface in their compound resonance, the light pressing against the silver-gold Acedia Infection and addressing it the way his own Infinity addressed it.
Alexander’s form blazed within the bubble as it sealed around him completely.
Then he was gone.

Noah had already sent the command to THE Infiniverse before the bubble fully closed, the instruction moving through their connection. THE Infiniverse had sectioned off an isolated domain outside her main body the moment the command arrived, a contained space separate from her primary substrate where the infection could be studied without risk of spread, where Alexander could continue fighting it with the Osmontian Absolute Infinity bubble providing external reinforcement while Noah determined whether the Causal Stilling’s infection mechanism had a cure available to him.
He didn’t know yet whether it did.
He intended to find out.

He turned to assess the rest of the lower Observable Existence, cataloguing the positions of the beings he needed to check on, the surviving unconverted existences whose locations his perception could still reach through the Stilling’s interference, the priority order of who needed to be found first.
He had already started moving when existence fluctuated at a point near him that had been empty a moment before.
He stopped.
He turned.

Sir William Arthur stood in the Stilled space of the lower Observable Existence, his presence settling into the coordinates with the easy authority of a being for whom arrival was simply a thing that happened.

His obsidian stellar suit was unblemished. His white shirt was crisp. His tie sat without adjustment against the shirt’s surface. The obsidian sheath at his side showed no evidence of having been drawn recently, its surface carrying the same composed readiness it had carried when Noah first saw him.
He looked at Noah.

"When lifeforms obtain immense power, paired with overinflated egos and the emotions that power tends to produce in beings who weren’t prepared for it, they arrive at a rather predictable conclusion."His voice carried its measured precision into the Stilled space without effort.

"They conclude that existence is theirs for the taking. That they may do whatever they wish, to whomever they wish, at whatever scale seems appropriate to their current mood." He looked at the silver-gold Stilling coating every coordinate around them.
"The result, as you can observe, is something like this."
He adjusted his jacket.

"THE Gilded Ones represent one particular expression of this tendency. A significant one, I’ll grant you, with their engineering and their civilizational infrastructure and their rather impressive capacity for manufacturing beings at considerable Scale." He looked at Noah directly.

"But they are one expression among many. There are others operating with equally unchecked convictions that existence owes them something, that the fact of their power constitutes a mandate for its use, that the beings living within existence are variables to be managed rather than lives to be considered."
He paused.

"Against such beings, existence cannot be passive. Nothing changes if those living within it simply endure what is done to them and wait for it to stop. We live. We move. We act so that events of this nature can be interrupted rather than completed."
His eyes held Noah’s.

"You are unique in having attracted the attention of THE Gilded Ones across time itself. That category of targeting is not extended to beings without significant standing, and your demonstrated access to at least the first letter of THE Primordial Tongue places you within a tier of consideration."
He straightened.

"You qualify as a potential entrant to becomeA Sword of Existence. A designation given to beings who, possessing both the power and the will to act, choose to move against the category of threat that treats existence as a resource rather than a home."
He let the silence sit for a moment. "As with everything worth having, it is a choice. I will not make it for you, and I would think less of the offer if I could."
He looked at the Stilled landscape around them, at the silver-gold luminescence that had replaced the Observable Existence’s prior vitality.

"Existence will always remain bright," he said."Its brightness will only ever dwindle when capable beings, beings with power and potential and the demonstrated willingness to use both, choose to do nothing. The beings who built these Ordnances are counting on the assumption that the cost of response will exceed the willingness of those capable of responding."
He looked back at Noah.
"Do you wish to grasp such an opportunity?"

chapters.title: Chapter 5287: Through Adversity! II
paragraphs: Noah looked at Sir William Arthur and thought seriously about his words.

He was operating across multiple bodies and multiple domains simultaneously. In THE Source Lands, his body with Eon was occupied with Dual Cultivation as he would eventually get back to hunting Galdr Source creatures and developing his Galdr Source deeper.
He had Persevere stacking every second through both his Source and his Osmontian Absolute Infinity. In THE Braneworld Observable Existence, he still stood within Velanthra.

In THE Infiniverse, now displaced into THE Undefined Gaps, the emergence aftermath was still settling, the nine Prime Cause regions developing, the accumulated authority of THE Infinite Cause still being stored.
Across the lower Observable Existence, he was standing in Stilled existence, the Acedia covering everything within reach.
A Sword of Existence.

The position was connected to THE Primordial Source. That alone made it relevant to everything he was already pursuing, because every path he was currently on pointed in that direction. It aligned with his position against THE Gilded Ones of THE Braneworld Observable Existence.

And anything connected to THE Primordial Source at the institutional level had to be old, genuinely old, filled with accumulated depth and capability and knowledge that no amount of cultivation from a standing start could replicate!
He would benefit from it tremendously.
He looked at Sir William Arthur.
"For much of my life I used to think about good and evil," he said."I asked myself which one I was. Whether what I was doing qualified as one or the other."
His eyes held a calm imperious quality."I know now it’s just countless existences making choices. Some smart choices. But many that are plain dumb and inexcusable." He let that sit for a moment.
"So sure. I would love to be part of something that takes care of the inexcusable."
BOOM!
Sir William Arthur nodded once.
He looked at the Stilled devastation surrounding them, the silver-gold luminescence coating every coordinate.

"Those with capability and potential who choose to act rather than recline are not many in the grand scale of existence," he said. "Existence is too vast, far too vast, and it is filled with too much for any single being or organization to account for all of it. Even Vakochev, who placed his name upon THE Scales and defined the framework through which most civilizations measure their power, cannot claim meaningful coverage of what existence actually contains."
He looked back at Noah. "So there are many Swords of Existence, and there are also few. The numbers are large in absolute terms and entirely inadequate in proportional ones."
He straightened his jacket.

"Since you have chosen, I, Sir William, shall act as your sponsor. To become a Sword of Existence, one must possess strength and decorum above all else. After all, manners maketh man." Something in his tone carried the quality of a principle stated so many times it had become structural.
"I can sponsor you and introduce you. The rest is ultimately yours to demonstrate." He paused. "If you take these, you shall officially gain the distinction of a Trial Sword."
He waved his hand.
Two things materialized from the gesture with the unhurried clarity of objects arriving at their designated positions.

A suit of obsidian, sleek and structured, cut with the precise tailoring of something that had been made to exact specification rather than approximated, a white shirt folded beneath its jacket, an obsidian tie resting against the shirt’s surface, obsidian shoes completing the arrangement with the gleam of material that had been worked rather than simply colored.
Beside the suit, a blade in a blue-obsidian sheath, the sheath catching what ambient light the Stilled space still permitted and returning it in deep patterns.
Noah looked at them as infinity buzzed and gave him information.
|Lesser Existential Source Armament- Trial Sword designation garment.|

|Construction: Source-woven obsidian composite. The suit, shirt, tie, and shoes function as a unified Existential Source Armor when worn, the components operating as a single integrated system rather than as separate articles of clothing. The Source weaving running through the composite is continuous and self-referential, meaning damage to any component initiates an automatic regeneration process drawing from the ambient Primordial Source resonance the garment carries. Full regeneration from structural damage occurs within moments under standard conditions.|

|Defensive capability:The Existential Source Armor can reflect attacks from entities at THE Fourth Scale of Existence for a sustained engagement period. The reflection is not passive absorption. The armor reads incoming force and redirects it. Repeated Fourth Scale attacks within a single engagement will eventually exceed the reflection capacity and require regeneration intervals. Against Third Scale attacks and below, the reflection capacity is effectively unlimited.|

|Cultivation enhancement: While wearing the Existential Source Armament, thestudy and comprehension of THE Primordial Tongue and THE Primordial Source proceeds at one thousand percent the standard rate.The Source weaving in the garment creates a resonance with these foundational elements that the wearer’s foundations absorb continuously, passively advancing their understanding during the full duration of wear.|
|Lesser Existential Source Axiom: THE Sovereign Reckoning.|

|Construction: Forged by a Source Lifeform from condensed Primordial Source material. THE Sovereign Reckoning is not a standard weapon. It is a testing instrument and a teaching instrument simultaneously, its purpose being to identify beings capable of advancing along the path toward THE Primordial Source and to begin that advancement through contact.|

|The Exelissomai Source Fragment:Inscribed within THE Sovereign Reckoning’s foundational architecture is the Source Fragment of the word Exelissomai, the letter of THE Primordial Tongue meaning transformation and evolution through the complete shedding of a prior form. Beings who demonstrate the capability to draw THE Sovereign Reckoning from its sheath will receive THE Exelissomai Source Fragment directly into their foundations, initiating comprehension of a second letter of THE Primordial Tongue.|

|Offensive capability: THE Sovereign Reckoning can cut through the Sources of Fourth Scale entities when wielded with sufficient capability. Against Infinite Lifeforms, the blade can produce wounds that standard weapons cannot produce, its Primordial Source construction bypassing the defensive frameworks that Infinite Lifeforms generate through their Infinity expression.|
|Note: The blade will not leave its sheath for a being who lacks the foundational resonance required to receive THE Exelissomai Source Fragment. The sheath is not a lock. It is a judgment.|
