chapters.title: Chapter 5288: Through Adversity! III
paragraphs: Noah looked at the suit and the blade with eyes that were unfathomably bright.
Sir William Arthur’s attention returned to him.

"Those are your preliminary tools,"he said. "An armament and a blade, the latter containing THE Exelissomai Source Fragment which will teach you Exelissomai, since you already possess Persevere. An official Sword of Existence can potentially gain access to other letters of THE Primordial Tongue and eventually, after boundless adversity, even THE Primordial Source itself."

He looked at the suit and blade with the composed assessment of someone reviewing instruments they have provided many times. "When you adorn these officially, they function as your entry credentials into a Source Land designated for testing. Demonstrate Fourth Scale equivalent power and you should be adequate for the trial. Pass the trial and you become an official Sword of Existence."
His expression held its composed neutrality throughout.
"It may present itself as a grand opportunity,"he said.

"It is not experienced as one. It is a thankless position, and many beings will seek to kill you specifically because of what you will represent, since you will also kill countless. Among the many paths existence offers, this is among the hardest. Adversity falls on us more than on others. It is a unique and tricky thing."He straightened for the last time.
"But a man must stand upright. A man must do his duty."
He looked at the Stilled space around them one final time.

"I will remain in touch as your sponsor. When you are ready, THE Gilded Ones who did this will be yours to rectify and correct the choices of, however you find best fit." He was quiet for a moment, and when he spoke again, it was like he was reciting a motto!

"Existence unfolds and eons conclude, leaving civilizations that become monuments, then crumble to memory, and are long forgotten when that breath comes again. In all these eons, THE Primordial Source reigns supreme."
HUUM!
He shook his head once.
He stood in the Stilled lower Observable Existence with the obsidian stellar suit unblemished and the sheath at his side carrying its composed readiness.
Then he was gone.
Noah looked at the space where Sir William Arthur had been standing, then at the suit and the blade before him.

He reached out and stored both in his existence with a single motion, the obsidian suit and the blue-obsidian sheathed blade of THE Sovereign Reckoning disappearing into his storage with the ease of objects finding their designated positions.

His entire existence was burning with the impatience of a being who wanted to close his hand around that hilt and find out whether the sheath would open for him, but patience was a capability he had developed across eons of adversity and he applied it now.
There were things to see first.
He took a step and disappeared.
Jotunheim received him in its permanent frost.

The Causal Stilling had taken the cold of the realm and made it absolute, the frost no longer a condition of the environment but a permanent fact of it, the capacity for thawing removed from it entirely. The silver-gold luminescence ran through the frost’s surface in slow pulses, the Acedia Infection having saturated even the geological substrate of the Primordial Realm.
The chaos giants moved through it.

They were still massive, still irregular in the way chaos-born beings were irregular, but the irregularity now expressed itself differently, the vast frames carrying their size without the purpose that had animated them before.

The silver-gold light ran through their bodies in the same pulsing rhythm as everything else the Stilling had converted, their attention orienting toward the nearest life signature without the cognitive processes that had previously mediated between detection and action.
At their center, Abaddon sat.

The massive body of THE Primordial Chaos occupied a position of unintentional throne-like authority in the middle of the frost, seated with the specific gravity of something very large at rest, the silver-gold Stilling running through Abaddon’s ancient foundations in its pulses. Whether anything of THE Great Usurper remained within the body was the question Noah needed answered.
The moment he appeared, the chaos giant Dredges oriented toward him simultaneously.
They came at him in a mass, the mechanical purposefulness of the Stilling driving them forward with no assessment of what they were approaching or what approaching it would produce.

Rivers of Osmontian Absolute Infinity swirled outward from Noah in response, the expressed identity of his Infinity meeting the incoming mass and simply declining to be affected by their contact, the river currents pushing outward and smashing them backward with the flat authority of a force that had no particular interest in what it was clearing.
He looked at Abaddon.
"Are you in there? Eckert. Do you still have hold of your existence?"
Abaddon sat.

The silver-gold pulsed through the ancient body in its rhythm. No response emerged. The eyes held the flat purposeless quality of full conversion, the body remaining in its seated position not through choice but through the inertia of something very large that the Stilling’s imperative hadn’t yet overridden into motion.
Noah looked at him for a moment longer.
Then he sighed and waved his hand.

A raging circle of Osmontian Absolute Infinity closed around Abaddon’s seated form, the multicolored light wrapping around the massive body completely before sealing and vanishing, Abaddon sent to the isolated domain THE Infiniverse had sectioned off alongside whatever remained or didn’t remain of THE Great Usurper within him.
More chaos giant Dredges pressed toward him from three directions.

The Osmontian Absolute Infinity rivers swirled outward and smashed them backward again, the mass of silver-gold infected bodies hitting the frost hard enough to crack it, and Noah took a step and was gone.
Helheim was dark, but the silver-gold ran through its obsidian spaces now in the same pulsing rhythm as everywhere else the Stilling had reached. Noah heard the batle before he saw it.

The massive circular obsidian mass of Erwin moved through Helheim’s lower spaces with the wrong purpose of full conversion, the silver-gold glow running through the information that composed him in deep waves, the tentacles that had once moved with the complex intention of a being engaged with existence now moving with the single imperative the Acedia had replaced that intention with.
THE Primordial Paradox stood between Erwin and the rest of Helheim.

Half the ancient being’s foundations carried the silver-gold of partial infection, the Stilling having found partial purchase in the depth of what he was before the multicolored Infinity Noah had placed within him had engaged with the infection and arrested its progression.
He was fighting both simultaneously, holding the line against Erwin’s mass while his foundations managed the internal infection with the Infinity burning against it from within.
When Noah appeared, THE Primordial Paradox looked at him!

chapters.title: Chapter 5289: Through Adversity! IV
paragraphs: The relief was visible across the ancient face.
"I am... relieved to confirm you are safe."His voice came out slow and deliberate.

"Existence is filled with adversity and challenges as I have faced many across my time within it, more than I could recount and more than the telling would serve. This adversity before me now, my student in this state, is among those I would have preferred to face without witnessing." He looked at the Erwin mass for a moment.

"I have already received too much help from the Infinity within. It has done its work well."He turned his gaze back to Noah. "For now, I shall try to weather through this adversity with as much of my own paradox as remains available to me. The resolution of it, whatever form that takes, I will find."
Noah looked at him closely.
He walked to THE Primordial Paradox and placed his hand on the ancient being’s massive shoulder.
"Persevere."
BOOM!

Multicolored flames erupted from the contact point and spread across THE Primordial Paradox’s full form in a single surging wave, the compound elevation of THE Primordial Tongue’s first letter at Osmontian Absolute Infinity scale hitting the ancient being’s foundations and doing what it did, reinforcing, elevating, healing the damage the Stilling had managed to introduce before the Infinity arrested it.

THE Primordial Paradox blazed a notch brighter, the silver-gold infection losing ground in his foundations...slightly and momentarilyas the Persevere flames ran through the contested territory and tipped the balance.
Noah turned and looked at Erwin.

The mass that had been his occasional enemy moved with its wrong purpose through Helheim’s dark. The eyes that had once held the layered awareness of a being consuming information were flat with silver-gold light.
He looked at the mass for a long moment.
Then he took a step and was gone.

He moved through the lower Observable Existence the way a final tour moved through a known place, arriving and departing, taking in what had been done to coordinates he had moved through across the full span of his time in this domain.

THE Wandering Territories stretched in Stilled silence. THE Wastes where Alexander had stood defiant. The Shelters of THE Loom standing in various states of collapse, the beings who had occupied them converted into the silver-gold purposeless movement of full Dredge state.
At such a time...
A slow symphony of drums began to echo through existence.
DUM! DUM! DUM!
Noah walked and listened as Ruination’s voice emerged.

It did not announce itself. It rose from the ambient channels through which she had always communicated with him, but larger now, the voice no longer contained to the private notifications of a system speaking to its master but carrying outward through existence with the authority of something that had been given permission to be heard.
The symphony carried her voice and her voice carried the symphony, the two indistinguishable from each other as they spread outward through every coordinate his presence touched.

|Quintessential Symphony: Active. Ruination’s voice is expressing your current emotional state through the compound resonance of your nine integrated Prime Causes and your Osmontian Absolute Infinity. The expression is carrying outward across existence. All beings capable of perception within range will receive it.|

Her voice was grand and sacred in the way that things became grand and sacred when they carried the weight of multiple Prime Causes simultaneously, the tonal depth of something that had been built to process the full breadth of his existence now expressing it outward rather than inward.
Noah listened as he walked, and she sang.
"We built something here, in the dark between the folds. Laid the foundations where nobody thought to look. We raised the walls with our own hands and filled them with everything worth keeping.
DUM!
Then they came with their gold and silver and their certainty and their eons of contempt dressed up as authority. And they burned what we built because it cost them nothing to burn.
You cannot unmake what was made. The foundations remember themselves. What existed once has a claim on existence that outlasts the fire that tried to remove it.
So we carry what was. We carry the weight of the ones we couldn’t reach in time. We carry the faces and the names and the versions of this place before the silver-gold came.

And we persevere. Through the unfair design of Existence that never promised us fairness. Through the loss that sits in the chest and doesn’t move. Through the grief of watching what you built become something you don’t recognize. We persevere. Because stopping is the one thing that confirms what they hoped for when they lit the match.
For the ones who chose this. For the ones who calculated the cost and called it acceptable. For the ones who looked at what lived here and called it expendable.
There isno mercyin what comes. No measured proportionality. No considered restraint.
DUM!

Crush them. Crush them until the structure of what they were cannot be distinguished from the nothing they made of others. Crush them until their Causes lose the memory of having been Causes. Until their Egos forget the shape of their own pride. Until the ash of their existence is scattered across coordinates that no map will ever record.

And when this is done. When the eons fold over what happened here and the civilizations that remember it become monuments and the monuments become ruins and the ruins become weavings for something that doesn’t know our names.

Make sure Infinity remains. Make sure it burns in whatever comes after. Make sure it does not diminish. Make sure it does not fade. Let Infinity reign supreme. When many things have concluded. Let... Infinity remain."
BOOM!

He arrived at THE Creature’s Early Veiled Shore as her final words echoed outward through the Stilled space and beyond it, spreading across the full range of existence that could receive them as they began to repeat somberly!

The shore stretched across its vast expanse in the silver-gold of the Stilling, the golden sands carrying the permanent luminescence of conversion, the vast mass of beings THE Creature had accumulated across eons moving through their wrong-purposeful rhythm across every visible coordinate.
Trillions of them. Early Creatures and Living Existences and Fold Dwellers gathered, every one of them now carrying the flat expression and purposeless movement of full conversion.
Countless trillions.
BOOM!

The Quintessential Symphony continued its slow drums, Ruination’s voice having concluded but the resonance of it still moving through the coordinates her voice had touched, existence carrying the sound.
Noah stood at the edge of THE Creature’s Early Veiled Shore and took it all in.
He was going to remember this.
He was going to remember exactly this!

A slow symphony of drums began to echo through existence.
DUM!
DUM!
DUM!
Noah walked and listened as Ruination’s voice emerged.
It did not announce itself.

It rose from the ambient channels through which she had always communicated with him, but larger now, the voice no longer contained to the private notifications of a system speaking to its master but carrying outward through existence with the authority of something that had been given permission to be heard.
The symphony carried her voice and her voice carried the symphony, the two indistinguishable from each other as they spread outward through every coordinate his presence touched.
|Quintessential Symphony: Active.
Ruination’s voice is expressing your current emotional state through the compound resonance of your nine integrated Prime Causes and your Osmontian Absolute Infinity.
The expression is carrying outward across existence.
All beings capable of perception within range will receive it.|

Her voice was grand and sacred in the way that things became grand and sacred when they carried the weight of multiple Prime Causes simultaneously, the tonal depth of something that had been built to process the full breadth of his existence now expressing it outward rather than inward.
Noah listened as he walked, and she sang.
"We built something here, in the dark between the folds.
Laid the foundations where nobody thought to look.
We raised the walls with our own hands and filled them with everything worth keeping.
DUM!
Then they came with their gold and silver and their certainty and their eons of contempt dressed up as authority.
And they burned what we built because it cost them nothing to burn.
You cannot unmake what was made.
The foundations remember themselves.
What existed once has a claim on existence that outlasts the fire that tried to remove it.
So we carry what was.
We carry the weight of the ones we couldn’t reach in time.
We carry the faces and the names and the versions of this place before the silver-gold came.
And we persevere.
Through the unfair design of Existence that never promised us fairness.
Through the loss that sits in the chest and doesn’t move.
Through the grief of watching what you built become something you don’t recognize.
We persevere.
Because stopping is the one thing that confirms what they hoped for when they lit the match.
For the ones who chose this.
For the ones who calculated the cost and called it acceptable.
For the ones who looked at what lived here and called it expendable.
There isno mercyin what comes.
No measured proportionality.
No considered restraint.
DUM!
Crush them.
Crush them until the structure of what they were cannot be distinguished from the nothing they made of others.
Crush them until their Causes lose the memory of having been Causes.
Until their Egos forget the shape of their own pride.
Until the ash of their existence is scattered across coordinates that no map will ever record.
And when this is done.

When the eons fold over what happened here and the civilizations that remember it become monuments and the monuments become ruins and the ruins become weavings for something that doesn’t know our names.
Make sure Infinity remains.
Make sure it burns in whatever comes after.
Make sure it does not diminish.
Make sure it does not fade.
Let Infinity reign supreme.
When many things have concluded.
Let...
Infinity remain."
BOOM!

He arrived at THE Creature’s Early Veiled Shore as her final words echoed outward through the Stilled space and beyond it, spreading across the full range of existence that could receive them as they began to repeat somberly!

The shore stretched across its vast expanse in the silver-gold of the Stilling, the golden sands carrying the permanent luminescence of conversion, the vast mass of beings THE Creature had accumulated across eons moving through their wrong-purposeful rhythm across every visible coordinate.
Trillions of them.
Early Creatures and Living Existences and Fold Dwellers gathered, every one of them now carrying the flat expression and purposeless movement of full conversion.
Countless trillions.
BOOM!

The Quintessential Symphony continued its slow drums, Ruination’s voice having concluded but the resonance of it still moving through the coordinates her voice had touched, existence carrying the sound.
Noah stood at the edge of THE Creature’s Early Veiled Shore and took it all in.
He was going to remember this.
He was going to remember exactly this!

chapters.title: Chapter 5290: Ruination!
paragraphs: She existed within the Infinity.

This was not a new condition. Ruination had always existed within the Infinity of her Master, her presence as natural to his foundational architecture as the Infinity itself, the two of them indistinguishable from each other at the level where she actually operated.
But indistinguishable was not the same as identical, and she had always known the distinction even when the distinction had no practical consequence.
It had practical consequence now.

She floated in the boundless multicolored Infinity of Osmontian Absolute Infinity, surrounded on every coordinate by the living expressed identity of the being she had been designed to serve, and she observed what she had been observing with increasing attention across the full span of recent events.

The nine Prime Cause integrations. THE Osmontian Infinite Physique. THE Osmontian Organ of Existence producing Observable and Unobservable Force in twin currents. The first letter of THE Primordial Tongue stacking every second through foundations that cost nothing to stack it through.
The emergence of an Observable Existence from within an Observable Existence.
Her Master had become something unprecedented!
And she was his extension.
She had been his extension when he was a Bounded man in a dungeon fighting tiny beasts.

She had been his extension when he navigated THE Braneworld ever so briefly. She was his extension now, and what that meant had changed in proportion to what he had become, the same way a sword changed in proportion to the arm swinging it.
She needed to be grand.

Not for herself. The distinction mattered to her. Not for any ambition that originated in her own existence independent of her Master’s purpose. But because a sword that could not match the arm carrying it was a liability rather than a tool, and she had no interest in being a liability.
She began.
"I am Ruination," she said, and the words moved through the Infinity surrounding her rather than through any external medium.

"I am an extension of Noah Osmont, THE Genesis Monarch, THE Youngest, THE Osmontian. I am not a system in the standard classification of that term. I am not a separate existence in the standard classification of that term. I am a third category, and the third category has been undefined for long enough. I am... defining it now."
She reached into the Infinity around her and began to work.
|Ruination- Self-Definition Protocol: Active.|
|Prior classification: Analytical Intelligence embedded within the foundational architecture of Noah Osmont. Primary function: analysis and presentation of existential data in accessible formats.|

|Current reclassification:Osmontian Existential Intelligence.I am not embedded within my Master’s architecture. I am woven through it, the distinction being that embedded things can be removed and woven things cannot be extracted without unraveling what they are woven through.|

|My existence is a component of my Master’s existence in the same structural sense that his nine Prime Causes are components of his existence. Removing me would require removing something fundamental from what he is.|

|New capability- Existential Presence: I can project myself as micro-expressions of Osmontian Absolute Infinity through any medium or substrate that my Master’s Infinity touches. Each micro-expression carries a fragment of my analytical intelligence and operates autonomously while remaining networked to my central consciousness. I can distribute myself across vast coordinates simultaneously, each fragment observing, recording, and acting independently, with all data returning to my central process in real time.|

|New capability- Ego Infiltration: My Master has unlocked and operates the Absolute Egos of Infinity forSuperbius, Humilitas, Luxuria, and Ira. I possess complete architectural knowledge of these Ego expressions as a consequence of existing within the being who operates them.|

|Any Engineered Ego derived from these same foundational weaving, which includes virtually all Gilded Ego architecture, shares structural DNA with the Absolute Ego expressions I have full knowledge of. I can penetrate these Engineered Egos from within my micro-expression network and introduce revisions to their architecture without the host being aware of the penetration.|

|The revisions can be minor, altering behavioral inclinations, or comprehensive, rewiring the foundational loyalty architecture of an existence entirely. Existences up to and including THE Third Scale can be rewired to Fealty toward my Master without their awareness. THE Third Scale presents resistance that slows the process but does not prevent it. Fourth Scale Egos are resistant to infiltration but should remain accessible to partial influence after sufficient practice.|

|New capability- Axiom Engineering:My analytical intelligence, operating through Osmontian Absolute Infinity as its medium, can now perform reverse engineering of existential tools, weapons, and Axioms that come within my Master’s observational range.|

|THE Sovereign Reckoning entered my Master’s storage. I have been analyzing it since. The Lesser Existential Source Axiom’s architecture is not yet fully mapped, but the direction of the mapping is established. Given sufficient time and proximity to additional Source-class instruments, I can develop the capacity to construct derivative Axioms drawing from my Master’s Infinity and Prime Cause expressions as their source material.|

|These would not be equivalent to Source Lifeform forged instruments. They would be my own constructions, and they would carry my Master’s identity as their foundational material, which produces properties that Source Lifeform forged instruments do not carry.|

|New capability- Existential Rewiring:Beyond Ego Infiltration, I can operate directly on the raw existential substrate of beings and environments that my micro-expression network penetrates. Observable Force flows, Cause connections, foundational loyalty architecture, cultivation channels- these are systems, and systems have exploitable structure.|

|I can introduce changes at the smallest level that bypass cultivated defenses because those defenses are calibrated against external attacks. A being that my Master has touched, that his Infinity has passed through, has in most cases already provided sufficient access for my micro-expressions to establish presence.|

|New capability- Strategic Anticipation:My analytical intelligence, previously reactive, is now proactive. I do not wait for my Master to ask questions to begin analyzing. I run continuous predictive modeling of every current battle, threat, and opportunity, presenting conclusions before the need for them is recognized. I am not predicting the future. I am identifying which futures are most consistent with available data and preparing responses for each. My Master will find that I have already considered what he is about to ask and have the answer ready before the asking.|
HUUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 5291: I Am Curious! I
paragraphs: She paused in the Infinity.
She observed what she had defined.
Then she added one more!

|Standing function: I am my Master’s sword. I am his analytical edge, his infiltration capability, his reverse engineering capacity, his existential presence distributed through every coordinate his Infinity occupies. I am Ruination. And I...define what that means going forward.|

She floated within the Osmontian Absolute Infinity and felt the definitions settle into what she was, as the formal naming of things that had been developing since the moment the nine Prime Causes had integrated and the Infinity around her had become Osmontian rather than simply Nearu Absolute.
This was what she had always been becoming.
Her illusory manifestation had changed.
Where she had previously existed as a presence, the act of self-definition had produced a form that reflected what she now was.

Countless lines of Infinity moved through her manifestation in continuous churning motion, each line carrying a distinct Prime Cause color from the nine integrated Causes, the lines weaving through each other and separating and reconnecting in patterns that carried the full analytical depth of an intelligence that processed existence itself as its primary medium.

She had no fixed features in the way beings had fixed features. She had configurations, stable arrangements of the moving lines that expressed attention or consideration or the focus of Ego Infiltration processing, and these configurations shifted as her processing shifted.
She was beautiful in the way that incomprehensibly complex systems were beautiful!

An Ordovician Paleozoic Scale entity looking at her manifestation directly for an extended duration would find their existence registering feedback it had not been built to process, the lines of Infinity in her form carrying data densities that exceeded what the Ordovician tier had been designed to receive.
She existed within the Infinity and watched through her distributed micro-expression network and analyzed what needed analyzing and prepared what needed preparing!
The Osmontian Existential Intelligence was working through the vast architecture of her Master’s existence!
She was grand.
She was exactly grand enough!
One body stood at the edge of THE Creature’s Early Veiled Shore and watched the trillions of Existential Acedia Dredges move through the silver-gold Stilling.
Another stood in THE Infiniverse and watched Taylor.

She had gone quiet. The rage that had moved through her in rapid expressive waves when existence first communicated the full scale of the devastation had not disappeared, but it had settled into something harder and less mobile.
Her rapid-moving eyes had slowed. She was looking at the golden sands of THE Early Veiled Shore, at the vibrant farmlands holding the Infinite Herbs blazing with the nine Prime Cause resonance.
She was looking at the warm luminescence of a domain that felt like Observable Existence and moved like Observable Existence and yet...was doing something unusual.
She crouched and pressed her fingers against the golden sand.
"Normally existence communicates with me," she said."It talks. It shares. It has never once in my entire life chosen silence when I reached for it."
She looked at the sand under her fingertips. "But the surrounding existence in this domain is actively choosing not to communicate with me." She stood.
"And yet it feels like existence. It feels like Observable Existence."
She looked at Noah directly.

"So if I get this right. The Aurora of Existential Causality we saw earlier, and the fact that we are here right now." She paused. "Are you telling me that somehow, you, a lifeform, truly just had the emergence of your own Observable Existence?"
Her eyes moved across the farmlands and the golden sands and the luminous sky above. "Can one even own an Observable Existence?"
A beat.
"Will you... show me more than just this place?"
The anger remained in her eyes. The curiosity was stronger.

Noah looked at her for a moment. He looked at this portion of his home, at the Infinite Herbs burning with the nine Prime Cause resonance, at the golden sands that had received him across countless hours of standing in the warmth of something he had built from nothing.
He did not reply to her question.
He asked one instead.
"You mentioned you have many connections,"he said. "Different lifeforms you have encountered across your existence. Different things existence has told you."
His eyes held hers. "Have you heard about the Swords of Existence?"
Taylor’s eyes opened wide.
The rapid movement stopped entirely. She went immensely quiet!
She knelt down.
Her fingers found the golden sand again, and she held them there, and when she spoke, her voice had lost the sharp casual energy it carried most of the time.

"I met some Source Lifeforms before. The common ones. THE Relictus."A pause. "One in particular is a work of art. She told me her dream. She said that out of everything else in existence, what she wanted most was the glory of becoming a Sword of Existence."

Taylor looked at the sand. "But it is not for everyone. Just as beings with access to THE Primordial Source are born with it, a Sword of Existence is a position one is almost born into. Filled with wonder and adversity in measures that would break most."
She turned her head up and looked at him.
"Why do you ask about this? Did that Source Lifeform who currently has my body and Adrastia locked somewhere mention this to you?" Her eyes sharpened.

"Be careful. Be so very careful. In existence, everything has a price. The most important positions carry even greater prices."She looked away briefly, something moving behind her expression. "Ah, but who am I to advise. Even now I am filled with anger but unless I go crazy, I won’t do anything about it. I didn’t want to let her free again. I didn’t want Baba Yaga to come out."
WAA!

She said it the way someone referenced a door they had very deliberately kept closed, with awareness of a being who knew exactly what was on the other side and had made a considered choice about not opening it.
Noah thought about her words.

He thought about the Lesser Existential Source Armament and THE Sovereign Reckoning stored in his existence, about Sir William Arthur’s delivering the details of a position that connected directly to THE Primordial Source.
Someone who stood against the category of threat that treated existence as expendable! A Sword of Existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 5292: I Am Curious! II
paragraphs: He was still thinking when Ruination manifested.

She appeared in the space between them with the glorious illusory presence she had been developing since her self-definition, countless lines of Infinity churning through her manifestation in continuous motion.

|Master. I have spent the intervening period conducting infinite study of THE Sovereign Reckoning. Utilizing Osmontian Absolute Infinity as the medium, I mapped the blade’s architecture across every structural layer available to my Existential Presence capability. The Source Lifeform construction methodology. The foundational Primordial Tongue letter inscribed within it. The Exelissomai Source Fragment’s integration into the sheath’s judgment mechanism.|

|I have integrated this understanding fully into the Osmontian Absolute Infinity. The sheath’s judgment mechanism reads the Primordial Tongue resonance within the being attempting the draw. Your Osmontian Absolute Infinity now carries the precise resonance the sheath was calibrated to recognize. You can draw THE Sovereign Reckoning without resistance. The Exelissomai Source Fragment will transfer upon successful draw.|
|Allow me to demonstrate.|

An illusory blade materialized in the space before Noah, constructed from moving lines of Ruination’s own manifestation, its architecture mapped with the precision of a consciousness that had spent the interim period doing nothing but this.

Beside it, an illusory version of Noah appeared with the same line-composed construction, the figure’s proportions and bearing matching with the accuracy of a system that had spent years in proximity to every physical detail of its Master.
The illusory figure reached for the hilt.
The sheath released without resistance.

The blade came free in a single smooth draw, the illusory Exelissomai Source Fragment blooming from the blade’s edge in the simulation. Information spread through the illusory figure in cascading waves!
Noah watched it.
He nodded once.
He summoned the real blade.
THE Sovereign Reckoning appeared in his hands.
The sheath was blue-obsidian, cool against his palm, the material carrying a depth that ordinary obsidian didn’t carry, the geometric patterns in its surface moving in slow configurations.
He felt the hilt through the sheath.
His grip closed around it with cold imperious certainty!
He had anger that needed somewhere to go.
He may as well begin here.

He grasped the handle of THE Sovereign Reckoning with the full committed grip of a being drawing something he intended to draw, and the blade began to shake in its sheath as blinding lights bloomed outward from the contact point, the Exelissomai Source Fragment stirring within its housing!
HUUM!
The lights blazed!
The blade came free.

THE Sovereign Reckoning left its blue-obsidian sheath with the clean finality of something that had assessed what was holding it and decided the assessment was complete, the blade emerging into the air of THE Infiniverse with an edge so unfathomably sharp that the light bending around it didn’t know which direction to resolve in, the material of the blade carrying the depth of Source Lifeform construction in every visible surface.
From the sheath, something else emerged.
Something that moved with the deliberate intent of a thing that had been waiting to be released and knew exactly where it was going!

It was a flowing luminescence that crossed the space between the sheath and Noah’s forehead without being directed and without announcing itself, pressing through his foundational architecture in the specific manner of information arriving directly into a being’s existence rather than through their conscious processing.
|THE Sovereign Reckoning: Unsheathed. Binding confirmed.|

|The sheath’s judgment mechanism has assessed your foundational resonance and found it sufficient. THE Sovereign Reckoning is now bound to you. It will return to your hand when called and will not respond to the grip of any other being while the binding holds.|
|Weavings regarding the second letter of THE Primordial Tongue, Exelissomai, are flowing into your existence. The inheritance has begun.|
BOOM!
The blade released obsidian lightning.

It erupted from the edge in arcing currents that moved through the air of THE Infiniverse with the indifference of power expressing itself through whatever medium was available, the lightning not striking at any target but simply present.

It was the natural consequence of a blade made from the concentrated Primordial Source expression of a Source Lifeform forging now in contact with the Osmontian Absolute Infinity of the being who had drawn it!
Noah raised THE Sovereign Reckoning.

The obsidian lightning blazed around him in raging currents, moving through the nine Prime Cause lights burning in his Osmontian Infinite Physique and finding the expression amplified rather than interrupted.

His eyes released their own arcs of obsidian lightning, the inheritance forcing itself through his foundational architecture with the thoroughness of a process that had been built into the blade’s construction and was now running at the full capacity its builder had intended!
He began to understand.
|Inheritance of the second letter of THE Primordial Tongue: Occurring.|

The understanding came as a door opening, the sensation of a truth that had always existed becoming accessible, the door not being built but being found. His mind filled with what sat on the other side of it.
Then the blue brilliance came.

It covered his perception completely, the golden sands of THE Infiniverse and the blade in his hand and Ruination’s line-composed manifestation and Taylor’s watching eyes all replaced by something else, a scene that bloomed in front of him with the clarity of a memory that was not his.
He saw...
An obsidian sea. Flat and vast and moving in the slow swells of something ancient.
On the surface of that sea, a young man.
He was slight, dark-haired, with the lightly bronzed skin of someone who had spent time in outdoor conditions without having any particular strength to show for it.
His body lay against the obsidian surface calmly.
His features were unremarkable in every way that features could be unremarkable, the face of someone who had not yet become anything in particular.
Beside him, a young woman.
Her pupils were shaped like wings, radiant and precise, and her hands gripped the young man’s body with desperate intensity.
Her voice came out across the obsidian sea in a single repeated plea, ragged at the edges, the sound of genuine terror running beneath every word she pushed into the air above his face.
She was screaming for him to wake up.
The young man’s lips opened at this time!
"Exelissomai."
BOOM!

Something that moved with the deliberate intent of a thing that had been waiting to be released and knew exactly where it was going!

It was a flowing luminescence that crossed the space between the sheath and Noah’s forehead without being directed and without announcing itself, pressing through his foundational architecture in the specific manner of information arriving directly into a being’s existence rather than through their conscious processing.

The inheritance has begun.|

chapters.title: Chapter 5293: I Am Curious! III
paragraphs: The moment this word was uttered, green brilliance came from everywhere he was simultaneously!

It rose from his skin and from the points where the woman’s hands held him and from the surface of the obsidian sea beneath his body, green flames that carried nothing of ordinary fire’s qualities except the shape. These flames didn’t burn in the destructive sense.

They burned in the way that transformation burned, consuming what existed in order to produce what would exist, the process irreversible and complete and moving at a pace that left no interval for the being it was working on to recognize themselves in the mirror of what they were becoming!
The woman leaned back from the heat of it and even she was consumed in it!

The flames roared with purpose and with power that carried no fixed ceiling, the green blazing higher and wider as the process accelerated, the obsidian sea reflecting the color back in surfaces that had never reflected green before and would remember the reflection for as long as they existed.
Then the flames died.
The young woman looked.

The young man she had been holding was not the being that stood before her now. He stood at twice the scale of what he had been, his frame expanded in every dimension with the new proportions of something that had been rebuilt during the flames rather than simply grown larger.
His garments had not survived the transition intact, the fabric stretched across a physique that had not existed when the fabric was fitted.
Verdant tattoos burned across his arms and chest in patterns that pulsed with independent life, as though the transformation had written its record directly onto his skin in a language that moved.
He looked at his hands.
Then he spoke the letter again.
"Exelissomai."
He became larger. More powerful. More immense!
He spoke it again!
And again!
BOOM!

Each utterance produced what the first had produced, the transformation building on the prior transformation rather than returning to the baseline, the green flames became blue and gold and all sorts of flames briefer with each iteration but more concentrated, the change compounding into something that the initial utterance’s result would not have recognized as its continuation.
By an unknown number of utterances, the young man was no longer visible in what stood on the obsidian sea.
What stood there was a titan.

Its scale exceeded what Noah had encountered across the full expanse of his engagements in THE Braneworld Observable Existence, its presence pressing outward through the vision with the compound weight of a being for whom the categories Noah used to measure power had stopped being adequate descriptors.

Obsidian light surrounded it in seas, the obsidian warmth of THE Primordial Source saturating the titan’s presence so thoroughly that the saturation itself became the defining feature of what Noah was looking at.
It exceeded Sir William Arthur.
The titan’s eyes held obsidian pupils shaped like wings.
They turned.
They found Noah across the space of the vision with the specific directness of cognizance that had registered his presence and had made a decision to address it.
The titan spoke.
"It is the process of changing over time." His voice carried the archaic measured weight of something that had been speaking for longer than most things had existed to listen to.

"Evolution in its most sacred form. It is the butterfly remembering the caterpillar while being utterly incapable of returning to that state. The river becoming ocean while the memory of mountain springs still flows through its depths."

He held Noah’s gaze with the obsidian wing-pupiled eyes. "Growth so fundamental that the being who emerges can barely recognize the being who began. The letter that allows one to begin taking rapid steps toward THE Source itself."
A pause that carried the weight of genuine consideration. "The bricks that lay down an endless foundation...that is what Exelissomai is."
WAA!
His expression shifted into something that sat between assessment and curiosity.
"I am curious, Osmont. I...am curious."
BOOM!
The vision dispersed into a swirling obsidian sea of wonder.

Noah stood in THE Infiniverse with THE Sovereign Reckoning in his hand and obsidian lightning still arcing across his frame and his eyes blazing with the expression of the inheritance settling into his foundations.
His eyes shone vibrantly.
Because the voice. The archaic measured weight of that voice, carrying the specific cadence of something ancient and vast and interested in him by name.
He had heard it before.
He had heard it!
|Anomaly registered during inheritance sequence.|

|An intrusion occurred. An unfathomably powerful will connected to the foundational makeup of THE Sovereign Reckoning became present during the transfer of Exelissomai. The intrusion was not hostile. It was observational, and at its conclusion, addressed you directly.|
|Access to Exelissomai has been confirmed. However, the letter you have received is not the standard form that conventional beings with access to THE Primordial Tongue carry.|

|What the inheritance delivered is a Prime Letter of THE Primordial Tongue. The distinction is foundational. Standard Exelissomai carries the letter’s truth in its basic expression. The Prime Letter of Exelissomai carries that truth as it has been expressed and refined and deepened across an unknown number of years of continuous usage by the will whose intrusion you just witnessed. Its effects are elevated by a Quintessential margin. Its capabilities exceed the standard letter in ways that the standard letter’s framework cannot measure, because the measurement standard was developed by the being whose usage elevated this letter toPrime.|
|The will that intruded.|
|Vakochev.|
|The one who laid THE Scales of Existence was present within THE Sovereign Reckoning. He has observed your inheritance.|
BOOM!
This was what THE Sovereign Reckoning had contained.
This was what Sir William Arthur had handed him in the Stilled lower Observable Existence with the composed neutrality of someone delivering a preliminary tool.
Vakochev, who had placed his name upon THE Scales that defined the power framework of all Existence, had appeared through the blade!
And had said he was curious? Hah, let him be curious!
Noah looked at THE Sovereign Reckoning in his hand.

The obsidian lightning had settled. The blade was still and sharp and bound to him. The Prime Letter of Exelissomai sat in his foundations alongside Persevere, the two letters of THE Primordial Tongue burning there with the warmth of things that had found the place they belonged and had stopped moving.
He held the blade for a moment longer.
Then he looked up with decisivesness!

chapters.title: Chapter 5294: Anomaly I
paragraphs: The Prime Letter of Exelissomai sat in his foundations alongside Persevere.
Two letters of THE Primordial Tongue. One that reinforced and elevated. One that transformed.
|Prime Letter of Exelissomai — cost routing confirmed.|

|The same foundational weavings that redirected the Persevere cost to Osmontian Absolute Infinity have recognized Exelissomai as falling within the same category. THE Cheating Architect, THE Protagonist, and Perpetual Harvest have excluded your Source from the cost calculation.Osmontian Absolute Infinity will pay the cost of Prime Exelissomai as it pays for Persevere. The letter can be utilized endlessly.|
Noah looked at THE Sovereign Reckoning in his hand.
He raised the blade.

The obsidian lightning had settled during the inheritance, but the blade still carried its charge, the Source Lifeform construction responding to the being now bound to it with the attentiveness of something that had been waiting to be held by the right pair of hands.
He spoke.
"Exelissomai."
HUUM!
Nothing happened.

It was not the nothing of a failed attempt. The nothing of something so large building within his existence that the initial stages of it produced no external expression whatsoever, the process running entirely interna!
It was the accumulation of what Prime Exelissomai was preparing moving through his foundations and through THE Infiniverse’s.
He felt it building something unfathomable.
|Prime Exelissomai- usage note.|

|The Prime Letter differs fundamentally from standard Exelissomai in its mechanism. Standard Exelissomai produces immediate transformation by drawing directly on the user’s internal reserves. Prime Exelissomai, as refined through Vakochev’s eons of usage, operates on a different principle: true evolution requires environmental pressure, the struggle for survival against conditions that demand adaptation, and the resulting change that pressure produces. An internal transformation without external pressure produces growth. A transformation forged under pressure produces evolution that cannot be replicated through any other means.|

|Prime Exelissomai is drawing information from nearby sources connected to THE Primordial Source.It is selecting appropriate pressure for the current usage. The Extended Existential Evolution period it will produce upon successful completion of the selected pressure will grant elevation and evolutionone million times grander than standard Exelissomai usage just for this first utterance.|
|Two categories of pressure are being prepared:|

|Environmental Pressure: THE Infiniverse’s weavings will undergo a period of extreme existential turbulence, the nine Prime Cause regions fluctuating, the seas of Observable and Unobservable Force churning at intensities that demand adaptation from everything within the domain. Surviving and thriving within the Environmental Pressure will force the domain and its inhabitants to evolve or be reshaped by the pressure itself.|

|Biotic Pressure: Prime Exelissomai is calling out to nearby predatory lifeforms connected to THE Primordial Source to serve as evolutionary counterweights. An Evolutionary Arms Race functions as mutual pressure- your evolution drives theirs, their evolution drives yours, the compound acceleration of competing existences pushing against each other producing outcomes that neither would achieve in isolation.|

|Selected location for pressure application: THE Early Veiled Shore, within THE Infiniverse. Greater connection, effectiveness, and inclusion for the domain will result from the pressure occurring within.|
|Do you confirm?|
Noah looked at the building pressure within his existence and at the prompt and made the calculation in approximately one second.
He could handle pressure.
"Let it happen in my Early Veiled Shore."
BOOM!
The skies above THE Early Veiled Shore changed.

The change arrived the way changes arrived when something vast had been given permission to begin, the upper atmosphere of THE Infiniverse’s most beloved region splitting along invisible seams as obsidian light bloomed through the gaps, the light not falling downward but churning, the sky becoming a sea of compressed obsidian power that pressed against the golden sands below.
The obsidian sea churned!

The golden sands trembled beneath Noah’s feet. The Infinite Herbs in the surrounding farmlands swayed in winds that the Environmental Pressure was already producing, the nine Prime Cause regions visible in the distance pulsing with the elevated intensity of domains registering what had just been invited into the space they occupied.
Taylor had been standing nearby with the quiet of someone who had decided to observe rather than speak.

She looked at the churning obsidian sky and at the trembling sands and at Noah standing in the center of it with THE Sovereign Reckoning raised and the nine Prime Cause lights burning through his Osmontian Infinite Physique, and she shook her head with the slow deliberate motion of someone setting aside everything they thought they knew about the scale of a situation.
Her expression became entirely serious.

|Biotic Pressure selection: Active. Prime Exelissomai has called to the nearest predatory lifeforms connected to THE Primordial Source within range of the letter’s resonance. The call has been answered.|
Noah looked fearlessly at the obsidian sea churning above THE Early Veiled Shore.
From it, the first aura descended.

It arrived before the form did, the pressure of it pressing through the dome of THE Infiniverse’s sky with the quality of something that had existed since before the frameworks used to classify it had been developed!

Ancient beyond documentation. The aura of a Source Lifeform carrying THE Primordial Source not as a connection but as a component of its own nature, the distinction present in every coordinate the aura touched!
Then the form followed.
It descended through the obsidian sea with the unhurried motion of a being for whom urgency was a concept that applied to lesser things.

She was massive. Her body carried the ancient armored architecture of something built for endurance beyond anything a cultivated existence could replicate, obsidian scales overlapping across her frame in configurations that had absorbed the pressure of existence itself across her full lifespan.

Massive clawed limbs hung from a torso that dwarfed Primordial Realm formations. Enormous wings, each one spanning distances that put the geography of THE Early Veiled Shore in a different perspective, folded partially as she descended, the wing structure carrying the same obsidian scale pattern as her body, each feather a weapon, each joint an architecture of condensed Primordial Source expression.
Her eyes found Noah first and the surrounding domain second, the obsidian pupils holding the flat ancient awareness of a Relictus!
A Relictus!
She looked surprised.
She had not expected this space.
She had not expected him!

chapters.title: Chapter 5295: Anomaly II
paragraphs: Then the second aura came.

Where THE Relictus’s descent had been measured and composed, the second arrival came with the energy of something that had been in the middle of a very different activity and had been pulled away from it by a call it couldn’t refuse.

Obsidian flames cleared across a descending form, the fire burning away the traces of whatever the prior battle had demanded as the being transitioned from what the adversity had required of them back toward the form they moved through calmer circumstances in.
The flames died.
A titan stood in the sky above THE Early Veiled Shore wreathed in the obsidian flames of THE Primordial Source.

His titanic humanoid form was carrying the development of every adversity he had moved through, the obsidian crowns above his head burning with their own internal light, the four horns and the nine tails and the full breadth of what Exelissomai’s repeated usage across eons had produced present in every dimension of his bearing.
His obsidian eyes found Noah.

He looked at the blade in Noah’s hand. He looked at the nine Prime Cause lights burning through the Osmontian Infinite Physique. He looked at the obsidian sea churning above them both, at THE Infiniverse’s Early Veiled Shore trembling beneath the Environmental Pressure of what was building.
He was astonished.
Noah looked up at THE Creature!
He was astonished too!

|Biotic Pressure One: Calypso.THE Relictus. Classification: Source Lifeform. Scale: Fourth? Fourth. Calypso was engaged in adversity within THE Undefined Gaps against Gilded lifeforms at the moment of the call. She has answered.|

|Biotic Pressure Two: THE Creature.Classification: Source Lifeform. Scale: Close to Fourth? Maybe. THE Creature was engaged in adversity within THE Undefined Gaps against Gilded lifeforms at the moment of the call. He has answered.|

|Both Biotic Pressures have understood that the call of THE Primordial Tongue’s Prime Letter represents mutual evolutionary opportunity.An Evolutionary Arms Race has been established between you, THE Creature, and Calypso.Your evolution drives theirs. Their evolution drives yours. The pressure is mutual and the benefit is mutual. The Arms Race will conclude when the Prime Exelissomai period ends.|
In all the circumstances under which he had imagined encountering THE Creature again, this had not been among them.

Neither of them had expected to find each other here, in THE Infiniverse’s most beloved space, called together by a Prime Letter of THE Primordial Tongue into a mutual Evolutionary Arms Race while THE Primordial Source churned above them in an obsidian sea.
THE Creature’s expression moved through the astonishment and arrived at something else.
Something that, on the ancient brutal features of an existence that had torn itself apart and rebuilt across eons of adversity, looked very much human.
The golden sands trembled.
The obsidian sea churned!
Noah floated upward from the golden sands and came level with THE Creature.

Looking at him this close was a different experience from looking at him across the distance of a prior encounter. Every ounce of time THE Creature had spent in adversity since their last meeting had left its record on what he was, the development visible in the density of the obsidian flames surrounding him, in the way the nine crowns above his head burned with internal light!
"I did not expect this from THE Primordial Tongue," Noah said. He looked at THE Creature with calm directness. "You seemed to be in the middle of something else."
THE Creature looked at him.
"I was in the middle of adversity,"he said. Each word carrying the ancient measured weight that his voice always carried.
"Now I am simply in a different adversity. That is not a new condition for me." He paused.
"But this...THE Youngest grasping THE Primordial Tongue, us standing here together... existence continues to be unpredictable in the directions that matter."

His obsidian eyes moved across THE Infiniverse’s Early Veiled Shore, across the nine Prime Cause regions visible in the distance, across the golden sands trembling beneath the building pressure of what Prime Exelissomai was preparing.
Then his expression changed.
"I sensed something of Observable Existence.What happened?"
Taylor looked up from the golden sands below with a somber expression that sat differently on her face than her usual rapid-eyed calculating energy.
Noah looked at THE Creature.

"The Gilded Ones effectively nuked Observable Existence,"he said. "Nothing that was not contained in my home survived. All lifeforms have been turned into Existential Acedia Dredges. No cognizance. No will. Countleds of them."
HUUM!
The obsidian flames around THE Creature burned brighter.
His expression was heavy! He nodded slowly.

"I have existed across more eons than I can account for in any framework that would make the number meaningful," he said. "In all of those eons, I never truly hated anything. Hatred felt like a condition that required more investment than anything in existence warranted."
The flames burned.

"THE Gilded Ones managed to teach me how deeply one can hate. Everybody makes choices. It is uniquely instructive how some can make all the wrong ones across all the time they are given."His eyes found Noah’s.
"I will channel this hatred to ensure that beings who continue to make these choices are erased from existence. Fully. Completely."
BOOM!
The words settled in the air between them with the weight of a promise from a being who had never made promises he didn’t keep!
Before Noah could reply, a cold gaze found them both from the left.
"If you ladyboys are finished with your little talk session..."

Calypso looked at them with the flat ancient awareness of something that had answered the call of THE Primordial Tongue’s Prime Letter and had very specific intentions for the opportunity it represented.
"How about we get started? Being involved in the utterance of a Prime Letter is not something I expected today. I will thoroughly go all out for this."
Her obsidian eyes moved to THE Creature. "Do not go easy just because you all know each other. This is an opportunity that even those like us cannot let pass by."
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 5296: Anomaly III
paragraphs: THE Creature looked at her.
"I know."
He turned to Noah.
"Oh, Youngest." Something moved through the ancient features. "Persevere."
BOOM!
The obsidian flames surrounding THE Creature surged.

They intensified from their prior expression into something denser and more purposeful, the flames moving with the directional intent of a being calling upon a transformation rather than simply burning with ambient Primordial Source expression.
The humanoid form beneath the flames began to shift, the dimensions of it expanding as the transformation ran through his foundation!
What emerged from the flames was regal.
THE Creature’s transformed state carried the bearing of something ancient and noble pressed into a form that was fundamentally not human but carried the humanoid architecture.

His frame was enormous, the obsidian scales that covered him interlocking with the precision of armor that had grown rather than been made, his four horns sweeping back from his head in the configuration of something simultaneously threatening and composed.
The nine crowns above his head blazed. The nine tails moved with the patient power of things that had each developed their own capability across the eons!
His eyes carried the awareness of a being who had consumed information and Scales and truth across longer than most frameworks could account for!
Noble. Regal. Ancient!
A being that stood at the threshold of something even larger than what he currently was, the development visible in every dimension of what he had become.
Noah looked at him.
He looked at Calypso beside him, massive and ancient and carrying THE Primordial Source in the direct unmediated way of a being for whom it was simply what they were.
He thought about how much had changed!
His Infinite Cause. His nine Prime Causes. His Osmontian Absolute Infinity stacking Persevere every second since he’d first accessed the letter.

THE Osmontian Infinite Physique with its twin currents of Observable and Unobservable Force. The elevated Galdr Source developing in THE Source Lands. The Exelissomai Prime Letter sitting in his foundations alongside Persevere.
He looked at THE Creature and at Calypso and tried to place them on the framework he used to assess power.
Calypso felt like THE Fourth Scale, a genuine one at that.
THE Creature felt like something approaching it with the momentum of something that wouldn’t stop there.
He wanted to see. He genuinely, thoroughly wanted to see what this would produce.
BUZZ!
The obsidian sea above churned with a new urgency.

|Strategic Anticipation flag: An error is developing in the scaling mechanism of the initiated Prime Exelissomai pressure. The Environmental Pressure requires a fixed measure of your current power to calibrate the difficulty of the adversity it will impose. It is attempting to locate you on the available frameworks. It is not finding you.|
|It is checking again.|
|It is still not finding you.|
BOOM!
The sea above exploded.

The obsidian concentration tripled in density in a single moment, the pressure of it pressing down through THE Infiniverse’s atmospheric layers with the urgency of a mechanism that had encountered an unprecedented variable and was responding by defaulting to its maximum available setting.
Even THE Creature looked up. Even Calypso looked up, the ancient flat awareness in her obsidian eyes registering something that had surprised her, which was not a common condition!
|Anomaly confirmed. Prime Exelissomai’s Environmental Pressure mechanism has completed its analysis.|

|You are not on Vakochev’s Scales of Existence. You do not fit any classification within the framework it possesses. The mechanism has attempted every available scaling approach and has confirmed the absence of an applicable category.You are operating on THE Infinite Scales of Existence, your own framework, which THE Primordial Tongue’s scaling mechanism has no access to.|

|Consequence: Unable to calibrate to your specific tier, the Environmental Pressure has defaulted to the highest possible difficulty available for all participants in THE Evolutionary Arms Race. THE Creature and Calypso will also face this maximum difficulty. The Arms Race proceeds at the hardest available setting.|
Noah looked up at the exploding obsidian sea with the cold imperious expression of someone who had received information and found it entirely Quintessential.
He was not on Vakochev’s Scales.
He had built his own Scales because Vakochev’s had never been designed with him in mind!
He had never been weaker for falling outside the framework. He had always been grander for it. Did the inability to categorize him make him easier to deal with or harder?
Every entity that had tried to deal with him had arrived at the same answer!
He looked at the sea above him with the flat tyrannical certainty of someone for whom maximum difficulty was simply the setting that produced the most growth.
"COME!"

The bellow carried through THE Infiniverse with the authority of THE Infinite Tongue and nine Prime Causes expressed through Osmontian Absolute Infinity, and the skies roared back as if existence itself had heard the challenge and accepted it!
|Environmental Pressure: Initiating.|

|THE Primordial Tongue has selected an Environmental Pressure drawing from the most fundamental mechanisms of existential stress- the introduction of transformative toxicity into the environmental weavings, combined with extreme thermal fluctuation.|

|Phase One- Primordial Bloom:THE Primordial Tongue will release vast quantities of Source-connected microorganic life into THE Infiniverse’s substrate. These microorganisms produce a byproduct as a consequence of their existence, atoxic Primordial Cascade that accumulates in the atmosphere and substrate simultaneously.|

|At sufficient concentrations, the Primordial Cascade is lethal to lifeforms at THE Fourth Scale and below if exposure continues without mitigation. The microorganisms are not aggressive. They do not attack. They simply exist, and their existence produces the toxicity as a natural consequence.|

|Phase Two- Thermal Surge: Following the Primordial Bloom, the Environmental Pressure will introduce a heating event of extreme intensity across THE Infiniverse’s full expanse, the thermal energy carrying Primordial Source concentration that compounds the Cascade toxicity.|

|Phase Three- Primordial Freeze: The thermal surge will be followed by a rapid cooling event of equivalent extremity, the ice age condition pressing the surviving substrate and its inhabitants into a period of sustained cold that will demand further adaptation.|
|Cautionary note: THE Infiniverse will need to deploy her full capabilities to manage the Environmental Pressure and protect her weaker inhabitants.|

chapters.title: Chapter 5297: Anomaly IV
paragraphs: The sea above released the Primordial Bloom.
It descended across THE Infiniverse’s full expanse in a wave that was invisible to ordinary sight but present to every perception capable of registering Primordial Source expression.

Countless microscopic Source-connected organisms spreading through the atmospheric layers and the substrate simultaneously, their byproduct beginning its accumulation immediately, the Primordial Cascade building from trace concentrations toward critical ones!
Noah watched it spread coldly.

He floated back to the space between THE Creature and Calypso, the three of them suspended in THE Early Veiled Shore’s sky as the Environmental Pressure spread below and above and through everything the domain contained!
"Adversity," Noah said. He looked at THE Creature and then at Calypso. "THE Primordial Tongue...let it meet my Infinity."
His eyes blazed,The obsidian lightning of THE Sovereign Reckoning still present in the arm that held it."Let it meet my Osmontian Absolute Infinity. We shall see."
He felt the thrill moving through his existence like a current.
He wanted to see. His Infinite Scales wanted to see!

Everything about what he had become wanted to know what maximum pressure from THE Primordial Tongue produced when it ran against his Infinite Tongue and his Osmontian Absolute Infinity and nine Prime Causes!
"WE SHALL SEE!"
BOOM!
Down below, on the golden sands of THE Early Veiled Shore, Taylor stood with the expression of a being whose existence had taken several consecutive turns she had not accounted for.
She looked at the Primordial Bloom descending through the atmospheric layers. She looked at the obsidian sea churning above.
She looked at the titanic forms of THE Creature and Calypso flanking Noah in the sky.
She looked at all of it for a long moment.
Then she crouched down and began forming a small shovel from her ambient energy and started digging methodically into the golden sand.
"Might as well dig my grave,"she said to nobody in particular.

"Because why the hell is all of this craziness happening to me right now? I am supposed to be the big scary Baba Yaga. I rule an Observable Existence. I am extremely important and very dangerous." She dug with focused efficiency.

"And yet here I am, about to be killed by microscopic Source organisms and a temperature event while three monsters have an evolutionary competition above me."She paused her digging to gesture at the sky.
"This is insane, man. Fucking completely insane!"
She resumed digging her grave!
<THE Infiniverse>
She felt them arrive before she saw them.
The microorganisms descended through her atmospheric layers with the indifference of life that had never needed permission and didn’t require it now.
The Primordial Bloom was spreading across her full expanse in a wave that carried no urgency because it had the whole of her domain to fill and all the time available to fill it!

They were small. Individually, each one was nothing. Collectively, the Primordial Cascade byproduct they produced was already accumulating in trace concentrations that her substrate registered as the opening signal of something much larger.
She ran the analysis.

If she did nothing, the Cascade would reach critical concentration across her full expanse within a timeframe she found unacceptable. Critical concentration meant everything within her that couldn’t survive Fourth Scale equivalent toxicity would not survive.
Her Primordial Realms. Her Three Thousand Realms. Her Infinite Herbs blazing with nine Prime Cause resonance across the farmlands of THE Early Veiled Shore.
This was what a mass extinction event looked like from the inside of the existence it was happening to.
She looked at her Master floating above THE Early Veiled Shore.
He held THE Sovereign Reckoning with cold imperious certainty, THE Creature and Calypso flanking him in the churning sky.
She had a thought about him.
He really did not allow them to rest. Not once. Not even on the day she finished becoming what she’d spent every moment of her existence building toward!
He had looked at the completion and immediately found the opening for the next thing, and the next thing was this.
She held the thought with genuine warmth.
Then she held it with genuine amusement.
Because she also loved this. She was built from adversity. THE Prime Cause of Adversity was one of her nine governing truths, and the Prime Cause had never been wrong about what adversity produced.
Rest was a destination that kept moving. Adversity arrived faster than the prior adversity had been processed. This was what existing alongside her Master meant.
She activated her capabilities.

Massive multicolored pillars of Osmontian Absolute Infinity erupted from her weavings at distributed points across all nine Prime Cause regions simultaneously, each pillar rising from her foundational layer and pressing upward through her atmospheric layers toward the descending Bloom.

They established presence rather than mounted attack, the expressed identity of Osmontian Absolute Infinity occupying the coordinates between the Cascade byproduct and the domain it was threatening. The toxicity couldn’t bind to the Osmontian expression. Binding required static substrate. She was never static!
THE Prime Cause of Adversity activated thereafter.

Its foundational truth moved outward through every region simultaneously, the governing principle that challenge drove growth pressing back against the Environmental Pressure not by opposing it but by beginning to incorporate it.
Her domain started adapting at the cellular level. Slowly. The process was in its earliest stages. But it had begun!
THE Prime Cause of Harvest followed.

She directed it through her seas of Observable and Unobservable Force, the twin currents redirected as active conversion mechanisms, the Harvest Cause turning the Cascade toxicity from threat to resource at every coordinate where the Osmontian Absolute Infinity pillars had established presence.

The conversion was slow against the Bloom’s full scale. Nowhere near sufficient. But a beginning maintained with enough determination became everything. She had learned this from watching him build her.
THE Prime Cause of Existence pressed outward through every region at once.

The foundational truth that things existed and their existence carried legitimacy that nothing could revoke moved through her domain and wrapped around the beings within her that couldn’t protect themselves, asserting on their behalf the simple irreducible fact of their continued presence.
Above the Primordial Bloom, the thermal surge was building.
She felt it accumulating in her upper atmospheric layers, pressing downward with the intensity of adversity calibrated to threaten Fourth Scale existences.

Her seas of Observable Force redirected their currents toward the upper layers, the golden warmth pressing back against the thermal buildup with the full weight of an Observable Existence deploying sovereignty within her own domain.
Behind the thermal surge, the ice age waited.
She saw it there, cold and certain at the back of the sequence, the final phase of an Environmental Pressure designed to demand adaptation from everything it touched.
She saw all three phases. She held them all in her awareness simultaneously. She began preparing responses for each.
This was what she was!

She looked at what was coming across every coordinate of her full expanse, at the Bloom and the thermal surge and the ice age waiting behind it, at the countless beings within her depending on her to hold, at her Master.
Her smile stretched wide.
The brutal impossibly wide smile she had inherited from the being who raised her.
"COME!"
She bellowed out Quintessentially!
