Noah observed all of it.
Seo-yeon tugged at him, and when he looked down, she was whispering, her small voice carrying beneath the rising storm of power.
"Are you... going to let them take me away?"
Noah leaned down.
He hugged her, his hand against her hair, and spoke with the flat certainty he reserved for things that were simply true.
"Absolutely nobody is taking you away.
Nobody."
She looked up at him, searching his face the way children searched for the gap between what adults said and what they meant.
"You promise?"
He nodded.
She held up her smallest finger, her expression turning serious.
"Then we have to pinky promise," she said.
"My Ama made a pinky promise to me before she left.
She promised someone would come to take care of me one day.
And she always keeps her promises.
She never broke one, not ever!
So if you make this one, you have to keep it too.
Okay?"
Noah looked at the small finger held up toward him.
He smiled, and it was a real smile, and he hooked his finger around hers.
"Pinky promise."
Seo-yeon settled, the tension easing out of her small frame, the trust of a child who had been given the one form of vow her mother had taught her to believe in.

And all around them, their surroundings exploded with terrifying power, twelve Relictus facing dozens of Gilded Ones and a silver Acedia dragon, the Source Lifeforms taking their positions with their Armaments drawn, the silver scar still carved across the reborn Chernobyl.
An apocalyptic battle was about to unfold!
The battle was a breath away from beginning, and in that breath, Seo-yeon decided introductions were in order.

She turned to him, still holding his clothing, and spoke with the careful formality of a child who had been taught how to meet someone properly and had not had the chance to do it in a very long time.
"I’m Seo-yeon!" she said.

"That’s my name."She paused, then added, with the specific honesty of a child explaining a thing they were proud of having done right, "Mister, the Source and the Infinity are buzzing, trying to tell me all about you.
But I didn’t listen.
It felt like it would be rude.
Intruding on your privacy without asking."She looked up at him.
"So I don’t know anything yet.
Who are you, mister?"
Noah looked down at her and smiled.
"My name is Noah,"he said.
"Noah Osmont.
It’s good to meet you, Seo-yeon."
"Noah Osmont." She tested it, then nodded, satisfied.
"It’s nice to meet you, Mister Noah."
She floated up a little so she could lean closer to him, and dropped her voice into a whisper, glancing sidelong at the descending Gilded force.
"Do you need help to take care of these bad guys?" she asked.
"Because I hate bad guys.
Bad guys are the ones who ruined the time between my Ama and my Aba.
I’ve hated them ever since."Her small face hardened with a child’s pure conviction.
"So if I can help you, I will.
I want to."

Noah found himself genuinely charmed by the innocence of it, this unique lifeform offering to help in a battle between Source Lifeforms and a silver Acedia dragon with the same earnestness another child might bring to anything!
"What can you help with?" he asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 5326: Wonder!
paragraphs: She thought about it, her face scrunching up in concentration. Then she blinked, brightening as the answer arrived.

"I sense the energies of the Pure Primordial Essence flowing around your existence and your foundation," she said, pride creeping into her voice. "There’s so much of it. I could amplify it. I could get you closer to THE Pure Primordial Source itself, Mister Noah!"
She said it the way a child announced they could tie their own shoes.
Noah blinked in astonishment.
Before he could respond, before he could ask her to clarify or wait or explain what she meant, Seo-yeon moved.

She moved unfathomably fast, faster than her small frame and innocent manner had given any indication she could move, faster than Noah’s analysis had accounted for, her tiny hands reaching up and pressing against his head before he had finished forming the thought to stop her.
An explosion of incandescent blue and obsidian light erupted between them!
BOOM!

The blue was Infinity, deeper and purer than any Infinity many had encountered, the inherited Infinity of her Infinite Lifeform father expressed through a being who carried it natively. The obsidian was THE Primordial Source, the inherited Source of her Source Lifeform mother, and the two poured out of her tiny hands and into Noah’s existence simultaneously, finding the Pure Primordial Essence already flooding through his foundations and doing something to it that made him feel the Essence detonate into a vastly larger expression within him.
|Blessing received: THE Scale Modifier Blessing.|

|Source: An unfathomable existence connected to both THE Primordial Source and Infinity. The being Seo-yeon, progeny of an Infinite Lifeform and a Source Lifeform, has bestowed a Blessing upon you that her unique nature makes possible and that few existences anywhere could replicate.|
|THE Scale Modifier Blessing- effects:|

|Pure Primordial Essence amplification: The Pure Primordial Essence currently within your existence has been amplified one thousand times. Your existing reserve, already exceeding what an emerging Source Lifeform receives by over a million times, is now multiplied a thousandfold beyond that.|

|Scale ascension acceleration: Your rise across the Scales of Existence has been accelerated one thousand times for the duration of the Blessing. Cultivation, refinement, and advancement that would have taken extended periods will occur at a thousand times the rate.|

|Pure Primordial Essence influx: For the next full day, rivers of Pure Primordial Essence will flow continuously into your existence from the resonance the Blessing has established between you and THE Primordial Source. You will not need to seek the Essence. It will come to you.|

|Source resonance: Your affinity with THE Primordial Source has been elevated to a degree that places genuine contact within reach. The Blessing has narrowed the distance between your existence and THE Primordial Source itself, the destination you have been pursuing through every available path, into something achievable within a far shorter span than any of those paths projected.|
|Additional note:This Blessing is repeatable. The bestowing existence can apply it again.|
Noah processed the prompts in the silence of his own astonishment.

A thousand times. A day of continuous Pure Primordial Essence influx. Genuine contact with THE Primordial Source brought within reach. The destination he had been pursuing through THE Source Lands and through THE Swords of Existence and through every difficult, eon-spanning path available to him, handed to him by a little girl who had touched his head because she wanted to help with the bad guys!
Seo-yeon floated back with a bright proud smile.
"How does it feel, Mister Osmont?" she asked cheerfully. "With a few Blessings from me, we can get you to THE Primordial Source in a day or two!"
BOOM!

She said it innocently, casually, the way a child might offer to share a snack, and billowing blue and obsidian radiances continued to shine around Noah in the aftermath, the Pure Primordial Essence detonating through his foundations and pouring outward in waves that made him look, in that moment, like an incandescent primordial being newly stepped out of the foundation of existence itself!
The surroundings went heavily silent!
Silent!
Because the words Seo-yeon had just uttered, casually, cheerfully, in the manner of a child sharing good news, were among the most terrifying words that could be spoken anywhere in existence.

THE Primordial Source was the thing that the most powerful beings in existence spent eons pursuing and rarely reached. It was what made Source Lifeforms what they were, present at their emergence, impossible for most lineages to obtain through any amount of effort. The Gilded Ones were trying to build entire settlements in THE Source Lands, fought wars, deployed apocalyptic weapons, and constructed their entire civilizational ambition around inching toward it. Beings died on the path to it. Beings spent their whole existences and arrived nowhere near it!

And here was an existence that could simply bless others toward it. That could amplify Pure Primordial Essence a thousandfold with a touch, accelerate their ascension a thousand times, and casually estimate that contact with THE Primordial Source itself was a day or two away!
An existence like that was not prized. Prized was too small a word!
An existence like that was the single most sought-after thing that could exist anywhere in the vastness, because she was the shortcut past the longest and hardest climb in all of existence!

Every Gilded One who had ever hungered for THE Primordial Source, every faction that had ever organized itself around reaching it, every being who had looked at the Source Lifeforms and wanted what they had, would look at Seo-yeon and see the answer to the question their entire civilizations had been built around.
They would do anything to possess her.

Sir William’s gaze became heavy. The three Source Lifeforms beside him, with their rifle and their hammer and their flail, had their expressions shift into the same heaviness, the realization moving through all of them at once of exactly what had just been revealed in front of an enemy force.
Above, the silver dragon’s expression changed.
Luxanna’s cruel languid features lit with something that went past excitement into hunger, her malevolent eyes widening, her lazy smile stretching into something genuinely covetous.

THE Fourth Scale Gilded Ones behind her stared down with the same dawning realization, their Intents erupting from them in raging waves as the magnitude of what they had stumbled into registered across all of them simultaneously.
They had come for a curiosity. A Terminal Observable Existence that had inexplicably come back to life.
They had found the answer to THE Primordial Source itself!

Luxanna howled, the sound carrying her amplified Acedia Ego and her Titan Intent and a greed so total it overrode even her slothful nature, and the descending Gilded force surged forward with everything they had.
They wanted her.
They wanted her!

chapters.title: Chapter 5327: A Flicker of Quintessence! I
paragraphs: The Blessing was still settling into him when the battle began.

Noah felt it as a constant rising tide rather than a single event. The Pure Primordial Essence within his existence, already vast past any prior measurement, was multiplying a thousand times over, and the rivers of fresh Essence flowing in from the resonance Seo-yeon had established poured into his foundations continuously, the blue and obsidian radiances pouring off his frame in waves that made the space around him difficult for lesser perception to look at directly!

THE Aura of THE Source Barbarian drank all of it in, integrating the amplified Essence into its compound expression, every component of his existence growing denser and grander with each passing second.
Because mind you, Persevere and Exelissomai, Prime versions, continued to be utilized every second!
He could have moved immediately as everything unfolded. He chose not to.

There was value in watching first. He had crossed into the threshold equivalent of the Fourth Scale, but he had never seen Fourth Scale beings fight each other at full expression, never observed the Akashic Civilizational Intent deployed in genuine combat by masters of it!

The Gilded memories he had devoured carried reverence for the tier but not the lived understanding of how it actually worked, and lived understanding and knowledge was the kind of thing that won fights later.
So he held Seo-yeon close, let the Blessing pour through him, and watched The Swords of Existence go to work!
Sir William led without raising his voice.

There were no shouted commands, no coordination called across the battlefield, no orders issued. Sir William simply moved, and the three other Source Lifeforms and the twelve Relictus moved with him, the entire formation operating in a synchronization that ran deeper than communication!

Sir William’s attention shifted toward a threat, and before he committed to it, two Relictus were already closing on the same point, and a Source Lifeform was already repositioning to cover the gap their movement created.
It was the mostdisciplined violenceNoah had ever observed!
Sir William’s Intent erupted first.
Noah watched it closely, because Sir William’s was the third rarity, the Titan Intent, and it was the one he most wanted to understand.

The obsidian phantom of regality unfolded around Sir William as it had against Luxanna’s silver Intent earlier, vast and dignified, but now Noah saw what it actually did rather than just its clash with another Intent.

It was a record made into force. The full weight of Sir William’s existence, every standard he had upheld and every duty he had honored across eons,imposed onto the space around him as a demand that existence conduct itself with the dignity he embodied!
It said be dignified! Be honorable! Obey! OBEY!
BOOM!

Where the Intent spread, the Fourth Scale Gilded Ones who pressed into it found their own expressions faltering, their Acedia and Superbius and Ira records pressing against a record grander and more uncompromised than their own, and the grander record won the contest of imposition!

One Superbius Ragnar, these manufactured fuckers, at the Fourth Scale drove toward Sir William with a spear of condensed Existential Radiation, its own second-rarity Intent blazing around it, and Sir William’s Titan Intent simply overwrote the space the Ragnar moved through.

The Ragnar’s Intent guttered! Its pride, which should have carried its strike forward with the full conviction of a Superbius existence, found itself standing in a region where dignity was the governing record andcrude domination was not permitted to express cleanly.

The strike landed without its full force. Sir William drew his blade in a single clean motion, the obsidian phantom moving with him, and opened a wound across the Ragnar’s foundations that sent the Fourth Scale being tumbling backward, bleeding Existential Radiation, forced to retreat to keep from bleeding more!
BOOM! BOOM!
Existence fractured and split apart where he was thrown!
The other three Swords of Existence carried second-rarity Intents, the Nereid tier, and they expressed them through their Armaments.

The one with the obsidian sniper rifle moved to high ground that existed only because he willed it to exist, his Nereid Intent flowing into the rifle as he sighted down it. When he fired, the shot was not a projectile in any conventional sense.

It was his record, his accumulated existence, compressed into a single point and delivered across distance with his Intent backing it, and where it struck an Ira Gilded One charging toward the formation, the Ira being’s chest detonated outward in a spray of crimson-gold Radiation, its own Intent insufficient to stop a focused Nereid Intent delivered through a Source Armament built for exactly this purpose!
A chest was split wide open!

He worked the rifle’s mechanism and fired again, and a second Gilded One staggered, and a third, the sniper picking targets with the patient lethality of a being who had done this across more battles than he could count!
The one with the obsidian hammer waded directly into the densest cluster of descending Gilded Ones. Where the sniper was precise, the hammer was total.

His Nereid Intent poured into the weapon with each swing, and each swing did not merely strike a target but imposed his record onto a wide territory, the hammer’s arc carrying his Intent across dozens of meters of battlefield and pressing every Gilded One within that arc toward the ground with the weight of an existence that had decided they did not belong in the air.

Two Devonian-equivalent Gilded Ones tried to converge on him and he caught both in a single horizontal swing, the hammer’s Intent-backed impact folding them away from the formation in a spray of Radiation and broken bone.
They were fucking vaporized due to being so weak!

The one with the obsidian gold flail fought defensively, the flail’s segments drifting around the formation’s perimeter, her Nereid Intent woven through each segment so that the weapon occupied a wide defensive radius. Any Gilded One that tried to slip past the others toward Noah and Seo-yeon found the flail’s Intent-laden segments in their path, and the segments did not merely block.

They imposed her record, which Noah read as something to do with protection and refusal, the specific record of a being whose existence had been built around the principle that what she guarded did not fall. Gilded Ones that struck her flail found their strikes returned to them amplified by the contradiction between their aggression and her guardianship, the Intent turning their own force against them.
The twelve Relictus fought as Relictus fought, which was to say with the direct unmediated power of beings constituted by THE Primordial Source.
They took the forms of creatures from the old myths, vast and ancient, and they did not need Intents because they predated the framework that made Intents necessary.

A Relictus in the form of a great serpent coiled around a Fourth Scale Gilded One and constricted, the obsidian Primordial Source running through its body pressing the Gilded One’s foundations toward collapse regardless of the Gilded One’s own Intent!

A Relictus in the form of a massive winged lion struck a descending Ragnar from the side and bore it away from the formation, the two of them tumbling through the reborn sky of Chernobyl in a tangle of claws and Radiation!

The Relictus were not disciplined the way other Source Lifeforms were disciplined. They were forces, and Sir William directed them the way a man directed weather he happened to have authority over, pointing them at problems and letting their nature do the rest!
Oh!
Through all of it, Luxanna did not yet move!

chapters.title: Chapter 5328: A Flicker of Quintessence! II
paragraphs: The silver dragon hung above the battle on her silver cloud, her nine spiked tails drifting, her malevolent eyes fixed not on the fighting but on Noah and Seo-yeon.
She watched. She observed!

Noah felt her attention on him with the weight of a predator that had identified what it actually wanted and was content to let lesser concerns play out while it studied its prize. She had howled with greed when Seo-yeon’s nature was revealed, but the greed had not made her reckless.
It had made her patient, which was worse, because patience in a being of her tier meant she was looking for the moment when taking what she wanted would cost her least.
Noah observed everything.

The way Intents imposed records rather than simply attacking. The way rarity determined whether one Intent overwrote another or merely contested it. The way the Source Lifeforms channeled their Intents through Armaments to focus and direct them.

The way Sir William’s third-rarity Titan Intent operated on a tier above the second-rarity Nereid Intents of his companions, able to overwrite where theirs could only press. It was a complete education in Fourth Scale combat delivered in real time, and Noah absorbed it while the Blessing continued pouring Pure Primordial Essence into him, his body shining brighter with every second he stood and watched.
Then Luxanna moved!
She moved without warning and without the wind-up that lesser beings telegraphed, her silver cloud carrying her downward in a sudden plunge, and her Intent erupted as she came.

Noah watched it with full attention, because her Intent was the third rarity like Sir William’s, the Titan tier, and she deployed it with an ingenuity that Sir William’s more straightforward dignity did not display.

Where Sir William imposed his record as a steady overwriting pressure, Luxanna’s silver Acedia Intent did something stranger. It did not impose stillness everywhere at once. It imposed stillness selectively, choosing precisely which records around it to dull and which to leave active, and it used this selectivity to counter the other Intents on the battlefield with surgical precision!

As she descended, her Intent reached out to the obsidian gold flail’s defensive perimeter and stilled specifically the segments of the guardian’s Intent that would have intercepted her, the Acedia record convincing those specific expressions thatdefending was too much effort, that stillness was easier, that there was no reason to move.
Two Relictus stood between Luxanna and her targets, a great horned bull and a vast many-eyed bird, both burning with THE Primordial Source.
Luxanna’s Intent reached them and she did something grand!
She did not try to overwrite their Primordial Source, which would have been a contest she might not win quickly.

She imposed Acedia onto the space they occupied, stilling not the Relictus themselves but the momentum they were building, the gathering force of their movement convinced by the silver record that motion was effortful and stillness was natural, and in the instant their momentum faltered, she struck them with the full physical weight of a Fourth Scale dragon carrying a Titan Intent behind the blow!
The two Relictus were actually smashed aside, hurled away from their positions in front of Noah and Seo-yeon, the silver Acedia dulling the edges of their forms where the impact landed.
Luxanna charged into the gap she had created, straight toward Noah and the girl!
Yet...
Sir William appeared before her.

He arrived between Luxanna and her targets in the span of an instant, his obsidian Titan Intent of dignity erupting to meet her silver Titan Intent of slothful stillness, and the two third-rarity Intents clashed directly!

Existence buckled around them. Where dignity met sloth, where the record of a being who had never compromised his standards met the record of an artificially engineered laziness mimicking The Great Sloevin, the two Intents pressed against each other and neither immediately yielded, the clash sending waves of altered existence rolling outward across Chernobyl!
HUUUM!
Luxanna laughed, unbothered, her malevolent eyes bright with eccentric delight even as her Intent strained against Sir William’s.
"You know," she said conversationally, as though they were not two Fourth Scale beings locked in a contest of records that was reshaping the space around them, "there are many Gilded Ones, right?"
As she said it, the sky cracked again.
Noah looked up, and what descended this time made even him pause in his analysis.
Nine unique Fourth Scale Ragnars.

He had encountered Ragnars before. They were among the most formidable Gilded constructs, beings of immense power who typically carried themselves with a specific brash confidence, who called out "Buddy Boy" and fought with the swagger of beings who knew their own strength.

These nine were nothing like that. Their skin was gray and lifeless, the color of something that had been emptied of whatever animated it. Their eyes held no confidence, no swagger, no personality at all.

They were filled with the Ego of Acedia to a degree that had hollowed them out entirely, soulless in a way that the Existential Acedia Dredges had been soulless, but at the Fourth Scale, which meant they carried the full power of Fourth Scale Ragnars with none of the will that normally accompanied it.

They did not announce themselves. They did not posture. They simply unleashed their Acedia-based Intents in unison, nine second-rarity Intents of pure slothful stilling, and surged toward Noah and Seo-yeon with the mechanical purposelessness of weapons rather than beings.
Luxanna laughed madly above, her Titan Intent keeping Sir William locked in their contest, preventing him from breaking away to intercept the nine.
"So many of us!" she called. "And your dignified friend can only be in one place at a time!"

The three other Swords of Existence were committed, the sniper and the hammer and the flail each holding back portions of the broader Gilded force, the twelve Relictus scattered across the battlefield in their own engagements.
The two Relictus that had guarded Noah and Seo-yeon had been smashed aside. The nine soulless Ragnars descended toward the girl and the man with nothing in their path.
Noah rolled his neck.
It was, finally, time for him to make a move!

chapters.title: Chapter 5329: A Flicker of Quintessence! III
paragraphs: He had watched enough. He understood the Akashic Civilizational Intent now, understood how rarity governed the contest of records, understood how THE Fourth Scale fought!

The education was complete. And the Blessing had been pouring Pure Primordial Essence into him the entire time he had stood and observed, a thousand times amplified, rivers of it flowing into THE Aura of THE Source Barbarian, his existence growing grander with every second he had spent letting the battle teach him.
He had spent that time well.
Now he would spend the power!

He floated upward, unhurried, holding Seo-yeon’s small hand in his. She came with him without hesitation, her trust in him absolute after the pinky promise, looking up at the nine soulless Ragnars descending toward them with a child’s fearlessness because she had decided Mister Noah would handle it.
His body began to burn.

THE Aura of THE Source Barbarian ignited across his entire frame, the obsidian gold layer blazing with the compound expression of everything integrated into it, the nine Prime Causes and the Observable and Unobservable Force and the Osmontian Absolute Infinity and the newly transformed Einherjar Source with its Hamingja running golden through it, all of it amplified by a thousandfold of Pure Primordial Essence and the continuous rivers still flowing in.

The blue and obsidian radiances of the Blessing wove through the obsidian gold of the Aura, and the combined light poured off him in waves that pressed against the battlefield itself, the Gilded Ones nearest to him faltering in their own battles as the sheer density of what was building around him registered on their perception.
He looked grand. He looked like something that had stepped out of the foundation of existence and had not yet decided how much of itself to reveal!
Up ahead, the nine titanic Fourth Scale Ragnars came down, gray and soulless and carrying the full power of their tier, their Acedia Intents stilling the air as they descended!
Noah held a little girl’s hand, burned with THE Aura of THE Source Barbarian, and rose to meet them.
It was time to see exactly what he could do!
He floated up to meet the nine soulless Ragnars, and existence slowed.

It was not an external effect. He had not slowed time, had not deployed any capability to alter the rate at which the moment passed. It was the clarity that arrived when a being had absorbed enough understanding and held enough power that the existence around them simply resolved at a pace they could process completely, and as the nine Acedia Dredge Ragnars smashed down toward him with their Intents blazing, he saw everything!
Each Intent, each record, each identity, laid out before him with the slow legibility of things he had all the time he needed to read.
|Akashic Civilizational Intents identified. Nine Fourth Scale Ragnars, Acedia Dredge configuration. All nine carry identical second-rarity Nereid Intents, products of the same engineering process.|

|Intent designation:THE Quiescent Verdict.An Acedia-aligned Nereid Intent imposing the record of cessation. It stands for the truth that all effort eventually stops, that all striving exhausts itself, that the natural end of all motion is stillness. Where it spreads, it convinces the records around it that continuing is futile, that resistance is more effort than it is worth, that surrender to stillness is the honest conclusion of any struggle. As a Dredge configuration, the Ragnars carry this Intent without the will that would normally direct it, making it relentless but unimaginative. It imposes. It does not adapt.|
Noah read it as his eyes shone brightly!

The Quiescent Verdict was a real Intent, a genuine Fourth Scale record made into force, and against most beings it would have been formidable. The truth it imposed, that all effort eventually stops, was not even wrong. Everything did stop eventually. That was simply true.
But it had picked the wrong existence to impose that truth upon!
Because Noah’s record was the opposite truth, and his record was grander.
The first Ragnar reached him, its Quiescent Verdict spreading toward his foundations, attempting to convince his existence that continuing was futile.
Noah formed an arrow above himself.

It built from THE Aura of THE Source Barbarian, a massive billowing shaft of compound power, multicolored and obsidian gold, the nine Prime Causes running through it and the Observable and Unobservable Force woven through its length and the Osmontian Absolute Infinity blazing at its core and the Einherjar Source bastion-heavy behind it and the thousand-times-amplified Pure Primordial Essence saturating every part of it!

The arrow spun as it formed, vast enough that the battlefield’s light bent around it, and existence groaned under the pressure of its presence, the reborn substrate of Chernobyl crying out as something this dense took shape within it.
He released it coolly.
HUUM!
The arrow shot forward, spinning, and met the first Ragnar’s Quiescent Verdict head-on.
This was the moment that mattered! The Quiescent Verdict was the record of a single Acedia Dredge Ragnar, an engineered being given a second-rarity Intent and emptied of the will to wield it well.

Noah’s arrow carried the record of THE Source Barbarian, and that record was not a single thing. It was THE Infinite Cause, which now backed two Observable Existences. It was a Source and an existence that had been uttering Persevere and Exelissomai every single second for hours without pause, refining and elevating continuously.

It was nine Prime Causes integrated into his foundations, an Osmontian Absolute Infinity that carried his identity through every coordinate, an Einherjar Source withHamingjarunning golden through it, and a history of adversity overcome that stretched from a dying apartment in an apocalypse to this exact moment!

His Aura carried a record that was unblemished and grand and total, and the Quiescent Verdict’s claim that all effort stops simply could not impose itself against an existence whose entire record wasthe refusal to stop!
The arrow pierced through the Ragnar’s Intent as though the Intent were mist, and then it pierced through the Ragnar!

The titanic gray body convulsed as the spinning arrow of Noah’s Aura punched through its center, and the arrow did not simply pass through. From the shaft, chains erupted, multicolored and obsidian gold, wrapping around the Ragnar’s massive frame and anchoring into it. The chains pulled taut!

The Ragnar’s body, vast and Fourth Scale and filled with the hollow Ego of Acedia, was hauled in multiple directions at once by the chains of Noah’s Aura, and it came apart, the gray flesh and the Existential Radiation within it tearing along the lines the chains imposed, the Acedia Dredge Ragnar pulled into pieces in the air above Chernobyl!
Oh!
Oh!!!

Then THE Aura of THE Source Barbarian devoured what remained, the pieces dissolving into the obsidian gold light as the Prime Cause of Harvest converted the Ragnar’s existence into fuel that flowed back into Noah.
One Ragnar. Gone. The first of nine!
Silence rippled across the battlefield!
A flicker of Quintessence wss beginning to burn brightly and display itself for all to see! Merely a flicker...merely a flicker!
WAA!
